title: Vice President of Sales
description:
**We’re Hiring | Vice President – Sales**

**Company: Sanmarg Pvt. Ltd.**

**Location: Kolkata, West Bengal**

**Department: Sales & Business Development**

**Experience: 10 years**

**Industry Preference: Newspaper, Print Media, Advertising, or Media Sales**

**About the Role**

**Sanmarg Pvt. Ltd. is seeking an experienced, strategic, and results-driven Vice President – Sales to lead its sales operations, drive advertising revenue, strengthen key client relationships, and expand market presence in the newspaper and media industry.**

**Key Responsibilities & KRAs**

* Revenue Growth: Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve revenue, profitability, and annual business targets.
* Advertising Sales: Drive print advertising revenue across corporate, retail, government, institutional, and agency accounts.
* Business Development: Identify new markets, customer segments, and strategic partnerships to expand the advertiser base.
* Key Account Management: Build and maintain relationships with major advertisers, media agencies, and corporate decision-makers.
* Leadership: Lead, mentor, and motivate the sales team; establish clear targets and performance accountability.
* Strategic Planning: Develop sales plans, pricing strategies, sales forecasts, and territory-wise business plans.
* Market Intelligence: Analyse industry trends, competitor activities, and customer requirements to identify growth opportunities.
* Collections & Profitability: Monitor outstanding payments, improve collection efficiency, and ensure profitable business growth.
* Performance Monitoring: Review sales reports, pipeline progress, target achievement, and team productivity.

**Key Performance Areas (KPAs)**

* Achievement of monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets.

* Growth in newspaper advertising revenue and market share.

* New client acquisition and development of high-value accounts.

* Retention and revenue expansion of existing clients.

* Sales team productivity and individual target achievement.

* Improvement in profitability, pricing discipline, and collection efficiency.

* Development of strategic partnerships and new business opportunities.

**Candidate Profile**

* 10 years+ of relevant experience in sales, advertising, or business development, preferably in newspaper, print media, or the media industry.

* At least 5 years in a senior sales leadership role, preferably as a VP, National Sales Head, Zonal Sales Head, or equivalent.

* Strong track record of achieving revenue targets and leading high-performing sales teams.

* Established relationships with corporate advertisers, advertising agencies, and key decision-makers.

* Excellent negotiation, communication, presentation, and strategic planning skills.

* Strong commercial acumen, analytical ability, and experience in sales forecasting and budget management.

* Ability to drive business growth, manage large accounts, and lead sales teams in a competitive market.

**How to Apply**

**Interested candidates may share their updated CV at**
hr@sanmarg.in

title: Practice Development Manager, Ortho Kolkata
description:
**Department:**
Sales
  
  
**Location:**
APAC-India-Field based
  
  
**Description**
**Why This Opportunity Is Different**
Most sales roles focus on selling products. This role focuses on transforming businesses.
  
  
As a Practice Development Manager (PDM), you will help doctors and practices adopt new technologies, embrace digital workflows, expand treatment capabilities, and unlock growth opportunities that improve both practice performance and patient outcomes.
  
  
You will operate at the intersection of: Healthcare | Medical Technology | Digital Transformation | Business Consulting | Practice Growth | Customer Success | Commercial Leadership
  
  
This is not simply a territory sales role. It is an opportunity to influence how healthcare innovation is adopted and delivered every day.
  
  
**Why Align?**
**Build a Career Beyond Traditional Sales -**
At Align, you are not just responsible for driving revenue. You are responsible for helping customers transform how they work. You will become a trusted advisor to doctors and practice teams, helping them improve clinical confidence, streamline workflows, elevate patient experiences, and grow sustainable businesses.
  
  
**Join a Company Shaping the Future of Healthcare -**
Align's digital ecosystem integrates advanced software, AI and machine learning, digital imaging, visualization, biomechanics, and material science to deliver industry-leading solutions worldwide.
  
  
**Be Part of India's Growth Story -**
India represents one of the most exciting opportunities within Align's global growth journey. As Align continues to expand its commercial presence, digital capability, and operational footprint in India, you will have the opportunity to contribute to a business that is shaping the future of healthcare technology in one of the world's most dynamic markets.
  
  
**Role expectations**
**What You Will Do**
**Drive Territory Growth**

* Develop and execute strategic territory plans using customer insight, commercial data, and opportunity analysis.
* Grow existing customer partnerships while acquiring and activating new customers.
* Convert new and existing practices into advocates of digital orthodontics and clear aligner treatment.
* Identify high-potential opportunities and prioritize activities that drive sustainable business growth.

**Become a Strategic Business Partner**

* Build trusted, long-term partnerships with doctors and practice teams.
* Understand each customer's clinical, commercial, and patient-focused objectives.
* Act as a strategic advisor rather than a transactional seller.
* Help practices identify opportunities to enhance efficiency, adoption, profitability, and patient experience.

**Lead Value-Based Commercial Conversations**

* Conduct structured, consultative conversations that uncover explicit and unspoken customer needs.
* Demonstrate the commercial and clinical value of Align solutions.
* Differentiate Align through insight-led selling rather than price-based selling.
* Confidently navigate competitive environments and complex objections.

**Drive Digital Transformation**

* Champion the Align Digital Workflow (ADW) and associated digital technologies.
* Help practices integrate digital workflows into daily operations.
* Demonstrate how technology can improve predictability, efficiency, patient engagement, and treatment outcomes.
* Become a trusted advocate for innovation and digital adoption.

**Deliver Meaningful Customer Impact**

* Support clinicians in developing confidence and capability in clear aligner treatment.
* Share evidence-based recommendations and best practices.
* Help practices improve patient outcomes and treatment experiences.
* Enable long-term practice transformation through technology and partnership.

**What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?**
**The Strongest PDMs Are**
**Growth Builders |**
They see opportunities where others see obstacles.
  
  
**Strategic Thinkers |**
They manage territories like businesses.
  
  
**Trusted Advisors |**
They earn credibility with customers through insight and partnership.
  
  
**Digital Advocates |**
They help customers embrace new technologies and ways of working.
  
  
**Category Creators |**
They help shape the future of digital dentistry by expanding adoption and influencing change.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**
**Who We're Looking For**
We would love to hear from professionals with experience in: Medical Devices | Healthcare Technology | Diagnostics | Capital Equipment | Dental Technologies | Orthodontics | Healthcare Solutions | Complex Consultative Sales

**Recruitment Mantra Hiring Senior Manager / AGM – Sales & Business Development for Navkaar Aluform Services Pvt. Ltd.**

**Location:**
Kolkata

**Sales Territory:**
Eastern India

**Experience:**
10–15 years

**Qualification:**
B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering

**Travel Requirement:**
Approximately 10–12 days per month

About the Company

Navkaar Aluform Services Pvt. Ltd. designs and manufactures aluminium formwork systems for high-rise buildings, housing developments, townships and infrastructure projects. Its services include design, manufacturing, delivery, on-site technical support and after-sales assistance.

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced, field-oriented sales professional to drive aluminium formwork sales and business development across Eastern India. The role involves identifying project opportunities, building relationships with developers and EPC contractors, leading a sales team and converting enquiries into orders.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and develop business opportunities with developers, EPC contractors, consultants, government departments and institutional clients.
* Generate enquiries, build a strong sales pipeline and independently drive opportunities through to closure.
* Conduct customer meetings and site visits to understand project requirements and present suitable formwork solutions.
* Read architectural drawings and discuss formwork repetitions, construction cycle times and cost per square metre with clients’ technical teams.
* Lead and guide the sales team to develop accounts, strengthen customer relationships and convert projects.
* Manage commercial discussions and negotiations with prospective customers.
* Expand the company’s presence across Eastern India by developing new markets and customer accounts.
* Use digital tools, AI-assisted research and field intelligence to analyse projects, competitors and market opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal teams to support customer requirements throughout the sales process.

Essential Requirements

* B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering.
* 10–15 years of experience in the construction sector, including
  **at least five years in sales of aluminium formwork systems, Mivan-type systems or closely related solutions**
  .
* A proven record of personally closing system orders worth
  **₹3 crore or more**
  , with identifiable project examples.
* Experience managing and working through a sales team.
* Strong understanding of project sales, institutional procurement and EPC-led business.
* Ability to read architectural drawings and engage confidently with developers’ technical teams.
* Strong communication, negotiation and relationship management skills.
* Proficiency in Hindi and English; knowledge of Bengali will be an advantage.
* Willingness to travel approximately 10–12 days per month.

Preferred Qualifications and Experience

* MBA qualification or experience managing a profit and loss account.
* Existing developer relationships in Odisha, Jharkhand, Bihar, the North-East or Chhattisgarh.
* Experience selling to major EPC contractors such as L&T, Shapoorji or KEC.
* Experience working in a growing, mid-sized organisation.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Handypay Services Pvt Ltd is a finance and payment services company focused on helping businesses grow through reliable, efficient payment solutions. The organization supports merchants in managing transactions and financial operations more smoothly and securely. By combining technology-driven services with customer-focused support, Handypay enables businesses to streamline payments and improve cash flow. The company is committed to building long-term partnerships and offering tools that make it easier for clients to expand and succeed.
  
**Role Description**
The Business Development Manager role is a full-time, on-site position based in the Kolkata metropolitan area. The individual in this role will identify and pursue new business opportunities, build and maintain relationships with merchants and partners, and expand Handypay’s presence in the finance and payment services market. * Demonstrated experience in business development, sales, or account management within financial services, fintech, or related industries.
* Strong skills in lead generation, pipeline management, and deal negotiation, with a track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
* Ability to build and maintain long-term client relationships, with excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
* Solid understanding of payment services, transaction processes, and basic financial concepts; experience with digital payment solutions is an advantage.
* Effective communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex solutions in clear, business-focused terms.
* Comfort working on-site and in the field within the Kolkata metropolitan area, including regular client visits and meetings.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, including the capacity to assess market opportunities and develop practical growth strategies.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proficiency in standard productivity tools (e.g., CRM systems, spreadsheets, and presentation software); experience with sales or CRM platforms is beneficial.
* Self-directed, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high ethical standards and compliance with company policies.

title: Sales Manager
description:

* Strong English communication skills, both spoken and written
* Experience working full-time in a professional remote environment
* Strong communication skills and confidence speaking with homeowners, property owners, business owners, or high-value prospects
* Experience running demos, presentations, consultations, or structured sales calls

* Ability to manage multiple leads and active conversations at the same time

* Experience selling services to homeowners, property owners, investors, landlords, or business owners

title: Business Development Executive
description:
**₹30–35K Fixed + Uncapped Incentives | Hybrid - Salt Lake, Kolkata | 10 AM–7 PM | Inbound Leads**

**We’re looking for a salesperson — NOT just a caller.**

**Bulltrack**
is a research-led stock market advisory and education company serving investors who want to make more informed decisions about their money.

Our clients are primarily
**35+ working professionals, business owners, retirees and HNIs**
who value credible research, clarity and practical market insights.

Our core offers include
**stock market advisory services and premium investment courses**
.

**What makes this role different?**

**Inbound leads only.**

People are discovering the company through its content and already have a level of trust and interest before they speak with you.

Your job is not to randomly pitch a product.

Your job is to understand
**who the prospect is, what they are looking for, their investing experience, their expectations and whether our offering is genuinely relevant to them**
— and then guide them toward the right solution.

You'll speak with inbound prospects, understand their investment needs, explain the relevant advisory/course offering, answer questions, handle concerns, follow up consistently and convert qualified prospects into customers.

**Your Responsibilities**

* Handle inbound leads generated primarily through YouTube and other marketing channels
* Conduct discovery calls and understand the prospect's investment background, goals and requirements
* Build credibility through professional and consultative conversations
* Understand whether the prospect is looking for
  **investment advisory, education or both**
* Explain product features, benefits and value clearly
* Handle questions and objections around
  **price, trust, product value, previous experiences and timing**
* Follow up consistently with warm prospects who have not yet made a decision
* Maintain accurate lead and sales activity records
* Keep the pipeline updated and ensure prospects don't get missed
* Work toward monthly sales and revenue targets
* Participate in call reviews, sales coaching and role plays
* Continuously improve product knowledge, communication and closing ability

**Follow-up is a major part of this role.**

The current business receives approximately
**100–300 leads per month**
, and one of the biggest challenges is that interested prospects can be missed because of inconsistent follow-up and lack of structured tracking.

**Who We're Looking For**

**You should have:**

* **1–2 years of sales / BDA / inside sales experience**
* Experience in
  **stock markets, financial products, investment education or a related domain**
  is preferred
* Knowledge of finance, the stock market & investment is preferred
* Strong interest or understanding of the
  **stock market**
* Ability to sell through a
  **high-ticket consultative approach**
* Strong follow-up management skills
* Good CRM and pipeline discipline
* Strong closing and negotiation ability
* Good understanding of sales psychology
* Excellent spoken and written English
* Professional, polished communication
* Ability to understand product features and explain benefits clearly
* Comfortable working with warm inbound leads
* Strong ownership and accountability

**Industry Preference**

**Stock Markets / Financial Services / Investment Education**

You don't need to be a market expert on Day 1.

But you
**must be willing and able to understand the product and the domain deeply enough to have an intelligent conversation with an investor.**

A salesperson with insufficient understanding of the product or financial-market domain is unlikely to succeed in this role.

You don't need to be overly aggressive.

**You need to be able to:**

* Ask the right questions
* Listen carefully
* Understand the investor before pitching
* Build credibility quickly
* Explain complex ideas simply
* Identify the prospect's actual requirement
* Connect product benefits to their needs
* Handle objections professionally
* Follow up without giving up
* Maintain a clean pipeline
* Take ownership of every lead assigned to you
* **Confidently ask for the sale**

You understand that with a premium financial product,
**trust comes before the transaction.**

You don't pressure prospects into buying.

You help them understand
**whether the solution is right for them — and why.**

**You Are NOT The Right Fit If...**

* You only want to make calls without taking ownership of conversions
* You dislike follow-ups
* You wait for prospects to come back instead of actively managing the pipeline
* You have little interest in stock markets or financial products
* You don't want to learn the product deeply
* You rely on aggressive or manipulative sales tactics
* You struggle to explain product value
* You need constant supervision to manage your leads
* You have poor written or verbal communication

**Compensation**

₹30,000–₹35,000/month Fixed + Performance-Based Incentives

Your earning potential grows with your ability to
**convert qualified prospects and generate revenue**
.

The role is designed for someone who wants to build a genuine career in
**consultative sales and financial-market products**
.

**What You'll Get**

**Warm Inbound Leads • Product & Sales Training • Call Reviews • Sales Coaching • Role Plays • High-Ticket Sales Experience • Career Growth • Performance Incentives**

You'll get exposure to selling premium stock-market advisory and education products to an audience that already has an interest in investing and financial markets.

**﻿Apply Now!**

title: Fundraising & Investor Relations Associate
description:
* **About Us**
  :

Maverick Drones and Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Indian drone technology company focused on the design, development, manufacturing, integration, and deployment of unmanned aerial systems for defense, aerospace, industrial, infrastructure, and commercial applications. As we continue to expand our business and strengthen our presence in the drone and defense technology ecosystem, we are looking for a driven professional to support our investor relations and fundraising initiatives. The Role We are looking for a Fundraising & Investor Relations Associate who can identify relevant investors, establish meaningful connections, initiate conversations, and secure qualified meetings with potential investment partners. The individual will work directly with the CEO and take ownership of the investor outreach process, enabling the leadership team to focus on strategic discussions and investment opportunities. This is a hands-on role for someone who understands how investment networks work and is confident in engaging with venture capital funds, family offices, private investment firms, HNIs, UHNIs, and strategic investors.

* **Key Responsibilities:**

**Investor identification and research**

● Identify and build a pipeline of venture capital funds, family offices, private investment firms, HNIs, UHNIs, and strategic investors.

● Research investors specializing in defense, aerospace, drones, robotics, deep tech, advanced manufacturing, and dual-use technologies.

● Identify relevant fund managers, partners, investment directors, and other decision-makers.

● Assess investor mandates, investment preferences, sector focus, and portfolio fit.

**Investor outreach and networking**

● Proactively approach investors through professional email, LinkedIn, telephone, industry networks, and referrals.

● Introduce Maverick Drones and communicate its business proposition using approved investor materials. ● Build and maintain a pipeline of potential investors and develop long-term professional relationships.

● Follow up consistently and convert initial outreach into meaningful investor conversations and meetings.

**Fundraising execution**

● Schedule and coordinate investor meetings directly with the CEO.

● Manage investor communication from initial outreach through follow-ups, meetings, and subsequent discussions.

● Maintain an organized investor database and track interactions, responses, and next steps.

● Coordinate investor information requests and due-diligence activities with internal teams.

● Provide regular updates on investor engagement, pipeline progress, and upcoming meetings.

**Investor relations and transaction support**

● Assist in preparing pitch decks, company profiles, investor presentations, and supporting financial information.

● Conduct preliminary industry, market, and comparable-company research where required.

● Coordinate with external advisers, investment bankers, and other fundraising intermediaries.

● Identify relevant networking events, investment forums, and strategic opportunities to expand the company's investor network.

Practical investment exposure matters more than academic credentials. We are particularly interested in candidates who have practical exposure to investment banking, venture capital, private equity, startup fundraising, investor relations, or financial advisory.

● Approximately 1–4 years of relevant professional experience.

● Demonstrated exposure to investor outreach, fundraising, deal sourcing, investment research, or financial advisory.

● Candidates with established professional networks among investors or investment professionals will have an advantage.

● An MBA in Finance, CFA qualification, or other relevant financial qualification is desirable but not mandatory.

● Strong candidates with a bachelor's degree and relevant practical experience are encouraged to apply.

title: Territory Manager (Kolkata)
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  
As a Territory Manager based in Kolkata, you will play a crucial role in driving our business with a primary focus on
**Retail promotion**
alongside vital
**Doctor/HCP support**
. You will champion our
**OTC (Over the counter)**
and
**OTX (Over The Counter and Prescription)**
portfolios, ensuring our products effectively penetrate the pharmacy and retail markets. By managing distribution networks, executing sales promotion plans, and partnering with the Area Sales Manager (ASM), you will help us achieve our business goals.

* Drive Retail Growth (Main Line Business): Lead retail sales and market penetration by building strong, lasting relationships with pharmacies, chemists, and retail partners to ensure optimal placement and movement of our OTC and OTX product lines

* Territory Planning: Assist the ASM in planning for the territory by providing retail market environment insights to estimate yearly demand, submitting distributor-level inventory requirements, and monitoring the stock availability of promotional materials
* Merchandising & Activation: Prepare and execute monthly retail sales promotion plans—including in-store field activation and pharmacy merchandising activities—and meticulously record expenses and sales generated to evaluate program efficacy
* Target Achievement: Ensure the month-wise achievement of your targets and execute SKU-wise monthly sales plans by actively generating secondary sales in the retail market
* Network Management: Manage the distribution network by monitoring distributor performance, proposing the appointment of new distributors, or recommending the termination of non-performing ones
* Stakeholder Engagement: Motivate distributors, dealers, and retail chemists through regular visits, calls, and correspondence, helping to resolve their concerns regarding accounts, pricing, competition, and schemes
* Strategic Meetings & Collections: Organize distributor and retail dealer meetings in alignment with marketing strategies and ensure successful monthly collections through continuous follow-ups
* Market Intelligence: Act as the eyes and ears of the market by monitoring competitor activities in the retail space, addressing customer or dealer complaints by forwarding them to customer care, and ensuring daily reporting of your visits

**Who You Are**

* You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, or a related field
* You have proven practical experience in pharmacy sales, distribution management, or a territory management role
* Product Expertise: You bring highly preferred experience working with OTC (over-the-counter) and/or OTX (Over-the-Counter and Prescription) pharmaceutical products
* You have a strong interest in driving retail market growth, with a focus on pharmacy relationship building, demand generation, and executing in-store marketing strategies
* You have excellent communication and negotiation skills and are confident in handling Chemist, dealer, and Doctor interactions, resolving issues, and conducting promotional meetings
* You are highly organized and diligent with administrative tasks, including daily/weekly/monthly reporting, tracking expenses, and managing collections
* You are comfortable with field travel within the Kolkata territory and thrive in a structured environment where you collaborate closely with the Area Sales Manager

Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  
**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

description:

**1. International Sales & Business Development**

* Identify and develop new business opportunities in international markets.
* Generate leads and connect with overseas buyers, brands, buying houses, and distributors.
* Develop business across key markets, including the USA, UK, Europe, and the Middle East.

* Attend buyer meetings, virtual discussions, and trade fairs as required.
* Address buyer queries and coordinate with internal teams to resolve issues.

* Negotiate prices, minimum order quantities (MOQs), payment terms, and delivery timelines.

* Monitor the sales pipeline and maintain regular follow-ups to secure business.

* Coordinate with merchandising, production, sourcing, and quality teams for order execution.
* Follow up on sampling, approvals, production progress, and shipment schedules.
* Ensure timely communication with buyers regarding order status and delivery commitments.
* Support export documentation and shipment coordination with the relevant internal teams.

**5. Sales Planning & Reporting**

* Maintain records of buyer inquiries, quotations, orders, and sales performance.
* Prepare regular sales reports, order pipeline updates, and business development reports.
* Track market trends, competitor activities, and buyer requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve sales conversion, customer retention, and profitability.

* Maintain accurate sales and buyer records in the company's systems.

With
**4,500+ registered users and 1,000+ monthly active users internationally**

**Business Development Associate**

* Opportunities to work closely with the founding team.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply directly through LinkedIn or email their CV to support@farmkranti.com, along with a brief introduction highlighting their suitability for the role.

title: Senior Manager/ Associate Director - Revenue | Kolkata
description:
As a Senior Manager/Associate Director - Revenue within our autonomous, geography-focused business unit, you will serve as a primary engine of execution and revenue generation. We do not look for traditional executors; we seek
**Growth Architects**
—professionals who view regional business, platform operations, and marketing through the lens of data, engineering, and first-principles thinking.
  
  
Operating within a fast-paced, high-velocity pod, you will collaborate cross-functionally to manage localized funnels, scale performance metrics, and optimize platform health to hit aggressive top-line and bottom-line targets.
  
  
**Purpose of the Role**
To deliver robust top-line growth and bottom-line margins through disciplined platform execution, targeted audience engagement, data-driven optimization, and tight cross-functional coordination. You will treat your functional domain as a system to be architected, tested, and scaled.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* First-Principles Growth & Execution
* Deconstruct complex performance funnels into measurable variables, managing full-funnel activation from new user acquisition to repeat engagement.
* Plan, execute, and scale on-app propositions, digital marketing campaigns, and sale event constructs end-to-end with absolute precision.
* Optimize live performance daily, utilizing conversion, traffic, and margin signals to make real-time programmatic adjustments.
* Commercial, Pricing & P&L Alignment
* Monitor performance metrics and financial margins across various categories to ensure regional growth is both competitive and accretive to the P&L.
* Liaise with central product, brand, and buying teams to negotiate optimal commercial terms, funding constructs, and localized SKU assortments.
* Strategically promote high-margin initiatives or products to systematically elevate the overall geography contribution profile.
* Data Modeling, Analytics & Platform Health
* Own end-to-end tracking of critical performance trends, identifying user cohort trends and operational gaps.
* Translate localized consumer and market analytics into actionable assortment, campaign targeting, and activation decisions.
* Maintain a strict focus on system stability, aggressively flagging and fixing operational gaps, pricing mismatches, or delivery supply risks.
* Experimentation & Supply Operations
* Design and execute high-velocity A/B tests or activation changes with statistical rigor, ensuring every modification is heavily data-backed.
* Coordinate meticulously with supply chain and internal teams to establish complete sync between live demand triggers and asset availability.
* Manage a structured activation and marketing calendar that flows seamlessly alongside macro events and business priorities.

**What We Are Looking For**
**Academic Pedigree**

* B.Tech / B.E. from IIT or other Tier-1 engineering institutes, or an equivalent heavily quantitative/analytical background.

**Experience & Competencies**

* Experience:4–8 years of professional experience in high-growth environments like e-commerce, quick commerce, consumer-tech, or data/business analytics.
* The Engineer Mindset:Intensely logical and structured. You possess a natural curiosity to understand the "under-the-hood" mechanics of any platform, funnel, or user cohort.
* Technical Savvy:Highly proficient in Excel/Google Sheets with exposure to SQL, BI data visualization tools (Tableau/Looker), or automation workflows.
* Cross-Functional Fluency:Demonstrated comfort and maturity in driving cross-functional alignments with brand, supply chain, and central product environments.
* Ownership & Grit:You have the zeal to build robust processes from absolute zero and the execution resilience required to thrive in a high-velocity, concurrent work environment.

**Good to Have**

* Prior regional, hyperlocal, or category management experience within quick commerce, marketplace, or hyper-growth consumer apps.
* Familiarity with app CMS platforms, digital promotion engines, or inventory optimization systems.

**The Perks**

* Direct Impact:You aren’t just running campaigns or updating a dashboard; you are actively engineering the growth engine of an autonomous business unit.
* Intellectual Autonomy:We foster a high-trust, fast-paced environment where hierarchy takes a backseat—data and logical arguments always win.

Kolkata, West Bengal

**Role Type:**
Internship / Trainee with opportunity to grow into a full-time role

**Function:**
Revenue, Partnerships & Gym Acquisition

**Reporting To:**
Chief Business Officer (CBO)

About MAVR

MAVR is building a connected fitness ecosystem for Trainers, Athletes and Gyms.

Our commercial goal is not simply to sell software.

We want to help Gyms hire better Trainers, improve operations, strengthen retention and grow their businesses while building a larger professional fitness ecosystem.

Role Mission

Your mission is to turn qualified Gym conversations into:

**Meetings → Employer Onboarding → Job Opportunities → Commercial Relationships → Revenue**

You will work directly with Gym owners, managers, studios and fitness businesses.

This is not a generic sales internship.

You will own part of MAVR's revenue pipeline.

What You Will DoGym Acquisition

* Identify and approach Gyms, fitness studios and other relevant fitness businesses.
* Reach Gym owners, managers and decision-makers.
* Understand their current problems around hiring, Trainer management, retention and growth.
* Qualify whether the Gym is a good fit for MAVR.

Employer Acquisition

* Introduce MAVR Opportunities to employers.
* Help Gyms create verified employer profiles.
* Identify genuine Trainer vacancies.
* Help employers publish real jobs.
* Follow up until applications, interviews and hiring activity begins.

Commercial Conversion

* Identify opportunities for:
* MAVR Opportunities employer plans.
* Assisted hiring.
* Gym Growth OS.
* Future MAVR commercial products.
* Book qualified meetings with the CBO.
* Support demos and proposals.
* Follow up until commercial outcome.

CRM Ownership

Every lead you work with must have:

* owner,
* stage,
* last contact date,
* next action,
* next action date,
* source,
* outcome.

No important lead should disappear because somebody forgot to follow up.

Starting Weekly Benchmarks

Initial pilot targets:

* 75 targeted outreaches.
* 20 meaningful conversations.
* 8 qualified meetings.
* 3 employer onboardings.

These are operating benchmarks and may change after MAVR learns actual conversion rates.

Performance & Uncapped Earnings

This is a performance-oriented role.

Qualified Meeting

**₹200**

Paid when:

* the correct decision-maker attends,
* the meeting actually occurs,
* genuine business need is captured in CRM.

Verified Employer + Genuine Vacancy

**₹500**

Paid after:

* employer verification,
* real vacancy confirmation,
* moderation approval,
* job goes live.

Revenue Commission

**10% of first collected revenue generated from accounts you commercially originate or close, subject to CRM attribution.**

There is
**no earning ceiling**
.

Examples:

₹10,000 collected →
**₹1,000 commission**

₹50,000 collected →
**₹5,000 commission**

₹1,00,000 collected →
**₹10,000 commission**

₹3,00,000 collected →
**₹30,000 commission**

Commission is based on actual money received by MAVR, not verbal commitments.

Retention Bonus

For selected accounts, MAVR may provide an additional retention incentive where the customer remains active after the agreed period.

This encourages quality customers, not poor-fit deals.

What We Will Not Reward

* Fake leads.
* Random bulk messaging.
* Meetings with irrelevant people.
* Fake job postings.
* Unqualified accounts.
* Unapproved discounts.
* Promising features MAVR has not approved.
* Deals not recorded in CRM.

Who Should Apply

This role is suitable for someone who:

* enjoys sales and business conversations,
* is comfortable calling and approaching business owners,
* can handle rejection,
* follows up consistently,
* communicates professionally,
* wants startup experience,
* is interested in the fitness industry,
* wants earnings linked to actual performance.

What You Will Learn

* B2B sales.
* Partnership development.
* Startup GTM.
* Employer acquisition.
* CRM management.
* Negotiation.
* Commercial qualification.
* Revenue generation.
* Fitness-industry business development.

Long-Term Growth Path

A strong performer can grow into:

**Business Development Associate**

**→ Senior BD / Partnerships Executive**

**→ City Revenue Manager**

**→ Regional Partnerships / Revenue Lead**

As MAVR expands beyond Kolkata, this function can become one of the major commercial teams inside the company.

**At MAVR, activity is not the goal. Commercial outcomes are.**

title: Senior Sales Executive
description:
**About the Company**

Renovar is an established manufacturer of sustanable packaging solutions, located near Kolkata, West Bengal. We specialize in high-quality PET Sheet extrusion and thermoformed packaging solutions.

We are looking for an experienced, performance-driven Sales Executive / Senior Sales Executive based in West Bengal with deep industry relationships in the rigid packaging and disposable food container market.

**Position Overview**

**Role Title**
: Sales Executive / Senior Sales Executive (B2B Rigid Packaging)

**Location**
: Kolkata (covering West Bengal & regional markets)

**Employment Type**
: Full-time

**Experience Required**
: 3 to 6 years in B2B sales of rigid plastic containers, thermoformed packaging, or disposable food packaging.

**Target Audience**
: Wholesale packaging traders/distributors, sweet shop chains, QSRs, cloud kitchens, food processing units, and bakeries.

**Key Responsibilities**
:

* Market & Network Expansion: Identify, onboard, and manage wholesale distributors and stockists in major trade hubs across West Bengal (e.g., Kolkata, Howrah, Burrabazar, Siliguri, Durgapur, Asansol). Directly target institutional clients, cloud kitchens, sweet manufacturers, food chains, and catering contractors.

* Volume & Revenue Generation: Drive monthly and quarterly sales targets for PET/PP thermoformed hinged containers and trays. Conduct regular field visits, present product samples, demonstrate locking integrity/clarity, and negotiate commercial terms.

* Commercial & Receivables Management: Ensure timely collection of payments and maintain clean payment cycles (DSO) within agreed credit terms. Manage purchase orders, coordinate delivery schedules with factory logistics, and handle customer feedback or quality queries.

* Market Intelligence: Track market trends, competitor pricing, gauge/micron specifications, and new product introductions across Eastern India. Provide feedback to the management/technical team for continuous product improvement and mould customisation.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
:

* Industry Experience: Minimum 3–6 years of proven hands-on field sales experience in thermoformed products, PET/PP hinged containers, or rigid plastic disposable packaging.

* Network & Relationships: Mandatory existing contacts with key packaging traders, distributors, and bulk institutional buyers in Kolkata and West Bengal.

* Product Knowledge: Strong understanding of container specifications (ml capacities, micron/gauge thicknesses, hinge locking mechanisms, and food-grade packaging standards).

* Communication: Conversant in Bengali, Hindi, and basic English.

* Mobility: Willingness to travel extensively across West Bengal.

**Compensation Package**

Competitive monthly base salary (commensurate with experience and candidate's existing network).

title: Senior Sales Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
At Zendesk, we’re revolutionizing what’s possible in Customer Experience (CX) and Employee Services (ES). Our rapid innovation and Agentic AI leadership have earned the trust of thousands of forward-thinking businesses.
  
  
We are seeking aSenior Sales Engineer to sit at the intersection of enterprise software strategy, hands-on systems architecture, and advanced AI automation. This is not a traditional generalist presales role. This is a role built for highly technical builders who are deeply curious about how autonomous agents, security, analytics, and deep integrations fundamentally transform how enterprise work gets done. You will own the technical strategy for our global customer engagements, acting as a strategic advisor to both the C-suite and engineering leadership.
  
  
Why This Role? Why Now?
  
  

* Drive the AI Revolution: Step into an elite presales environment where you will directly architect the deployment of modern Agentic AI workflows and Large Language Models (LLMs) for top global enterprises.
* Strategic Scope: Evolve your career by expanding your enterprise influence by presenting technical value narratives directly to economic buyers and C-level stakeholders.
* Innovative Culture: Work within an ecosystem designed to optimize human potential through advanced digital tools, where continuous learning, curiosity, and experimentation are hardwired into our daily performance.

Who We're Looking For
  
  
We are looking for a highly technical Individual Contributor who operates with considerable judgment and initiative. You understand the complex operational and financial implications of architecture choices and can confidently design customized enterprise-grade solutions. You have a passion for clean system configurations, combined with a sharp commercial mindset that links technical capabilities directly to business metrics, ROI, and organizational transformation.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Architect Agentic AI & Integration Workflows: Design, build, and operationalize advanced, agentic AI-driven customer workflows leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), deep prompt engineering, and modern automation frameworks.
* Lead Technical Architecture Discovery: Conduct rigorous, deep-dive technical discovery and AI readiness assessments. Translate complex system requirements into scalable pilots and proofs-of-concept (POCs) and enterprise-grade pilots that demonstrate clear business value.
* Build Scalable Accelerators: Proactively develop production-ready, reusable technical accelerators, middleware templates, and open-source-aligned API components that allow regional teams and Systems Integrators (SIs) to deploy Zendesk solutions at scale.
* Own the Technical Sales Lifecycle: Serve as the absolute technical authority from qualification through execution. Architect secure, scalable topologies leveraging Zendesk APIs, webhook frameworks, and leading cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Bridge Product & Field Strategy: Partner directly with Product Management and Engineering to provide real-world, technical feedback from the field, identifying product gaps and shaping the future roadmap of Zendesk's core AI and platform ecosystem.

**What You Bring To The Role (Basic Qualifications)**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in a related highly quantitative technical discipline is required.
* Experience: 6+ years of hands-on experience in technical presales, solution engineering, or a system architect/developer role within enterprise SaaS or complex software environments.
* Technical Fluency: Deep expertise with modern web and scripting technologies (e.g., Python, Node.js, JavaScript), REST/SOAP APIs, middleware frameworks, and cloud ecosystem architectures.
* AI/ML Expertise: Strong foundational knowledge of AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and autonomous agent deployment.
* Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of enterprise infrastructure, contact center tech stacks (CCaaS, telephony, workforce management), or modern IT Service Management (ITSM) systems.
* Travel Commitment: Ability and willingness to travel between 30% and 50% annually to lead critical, high-touch on-site customer architecture sessions and strategic regional briefings.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* A Master’s degree or professional technical cloud/AI certifications.
* Active engagement in the technical or developer community (e.g., open-source contributions, technical blogging, or community mentorship).
* Proven track record of designing reusable implementation guides, integration playbooks, or localization toolkits for global delivery partners and systems integrators.
* Experience flattening complex technical narratives into high-impact presentations tailored for executive, economic buyers and C-level stakeholders.

Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.
  
  
**The Intelligent Heart Of Customer Experience**
Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.
  
  
Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.
  
  
As part of our commitment to fairness and transparency, we inform all applicants that artificial intelligence (AI) or automated decision systems may be used to screen or evaluate applications for this position, in accordance with Company guidelines and applicable law.
  
  
Zendesk is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster global diversity, equity, & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment and employees at Zendesk are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an AA/EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer. If you are based in the United States and would like more information about your EEO rights under the law, please click here.
  
  
Zendesk endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to submit this application, complete any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participate in the employee selection process, please send an e-mail to peopleandplaces@zendesk.com with your specific accommodation request.

title: Area Sales Manager- Guwahati
description:
**Empowering careers at ARJO**
**At Arjo, we know what moves us. We go above and beyond for people facing mobility challenges. We take every opportunity to work and grow as one team and take pride in sharing our knowledge and experience. Does that sound like something that moves you too?**
**This could be your opportunity to begin a challenging and rewarding career in a healthcare company that empowers movement for people with mobility challenges.**
**Job Description About Arjo**
Arjo provides medical equipment and solutions for hospitals and elderly care markets, including pressure area care, patient handling, and diagnostic equipment. We are a market leader in medical equipment rentals and capital equipment sales, operating under ISO 13485 certified Quality Management System.
  
  
**Employer Arjo (ArjoHuntleigh Healthcare India Pvt Ltd)**
ArjoHuntleigh Healthcare India Pvt Ltd, a 100% subsidiary of Arjo AB Sweden is operating in India for the last 25 years and employing over 200 people in 39 cities. The company deals with products in Pressure Injury Prevention, Venous Thromboembolism (VTE) Prevention, Medical Beds and Patient Handling; in addition to holding a significant presence in the Diagnostics segment with products like Patient Monitors, Fetal Monitors and Dopplers. The company has pioneered the concept of rental sales in Corporate Hospitals of India with the products that it offers. The company commands a leadership position in the product segments that it operates in and enjoys the trust of Doctors and Nurses in over 1000+ major hospitals in India.
  
  
**Department : Sales**
**Role Purpose**
Drive sales of medical equipment and rental solutions to large corporate hospitals, ensuring revenue growth, customer satisfaction, and compliance with regulatory and quality standards .
  
  
**Role Overview**
Drive revenue growth by managing and expanding sales of medical equipment, rentals, and consumables across assigned hospital accounts. Build strong relationships with key stakeholders, lead product adoption through clinical engagement, and collaborate cross-functionally to deliver high-quality, compliant healthcare solutions while identifying new business opportunities
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Sales Achievement & Market Expansion
* Achieve annual sales targets and manage Accounts Receivable for the assigned territory.
* Identify new customers, develop high‑growth markets, and expand territory presence.
* Upsell and cross‑sell to existing customers, including rentals and consumables.
* Launch new products and drive their adoption in key hospitals.
* Key Account & Stakeholder Management
* Develop and execute account strategies for key hospitals.
* Build strong networks with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) — doctors, nurses, biomedical staff, and hospital executives (COO, CFO, CEO, CNO).
* Maintain strong relationships with C‑suite and other key decision‑makers.
* Collaborate with hospital project consultants on new projects.
* Customer Engagement & Product Support
* Lead effective product demonstrations and engage stakeholders to create awareness of how Arjo solutions address critical healthcare needs.
* Work closely with the clinical team on product trials, evaluations, and successful adoption.
* Grow and maintain long‑term customer relationships.
* Market Intelligence & Risk Management
* Monitor competitor activity and develop appropriate mitigation strategies with manager.
* Capture customer feedback, escalate quality‑related issues promptly, and support risk management documentation for equipment deployment.
* Cross‑Functional Collaboration
* Collaborate with internal teams — Clinical, Marketing, Service, and Finance — to align on market strategies and ensure smooth execution.
* Support sustainability initiatives aligned with Arjo’s corporate responsibility goals.

**Experience**
: Average of 3-5 years of experience in Medical Equipment Sales/ Medical Devices Sales/Specialty Pharmaceutical product sales / Hospital Sales .
  
  
**Qualifications**
**:**
Science/ Engineering Graduate / Non-Science Graduates holding a Full Time MBA.
  
  
**CTC Offered:**
As per market standards
  
  
**About Arjo**
**At Arjo, we believe that empowering movement within healthcare environments is essential to quality care. Our products and solutions are designed to promote a safe and dignified experience through patient handling, medical beds, personal hygiene, disinfection, diagnostics, and the prevention of pressure injuries and venous thromboembolism. With over 6500 people worldwide and 65 years caring for patients and healthcare professionals, we are committed to driving healthier outcomes for people facing mobility challenges.**
**For more information about Arjo visit**
**www.arjo.com**

title: Performance Marketer
description:
**Company Description**
Digital Wolf is a collaborative team of innovative digital marketers focused on helping businesses succeed in a competitive online environment. The company specializes in tailored digital marketing strategies that align with each client’s unique goals and growth plans. By combining cutting-edge technology with data-driven insights, Digital Wolf designs campaigns that maximize performance and return on investment. A strong customer-centric approach ensures long-term partnerships, continuous optimization, and measurable results for clients across industries.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Performance Marketer role based in Kolkata. The Performance Marketer will plan, execute, and optimize paid digital campaigns across channels such as search, social, and display to drive measurable business outcomes. Day-to-day responsibilities include managing ad platforms, monitoring campaign performance, analyzing key metrics, and implementing A/B tests to improve conversion rates and cost efficiency. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to refine targeting, messaging, and landing pages, while preparing performance reports and recommendations for continuous improvement. The Performance Marketer will also stay updated on industry trends and platform updates to identify new growth opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Campaign Strategy and Planning**

* Understand client/business objectives, target audience, offerings, funnel and conversion goals.
* Develop performance marketing strategies based on business objectives and available budgets.
* Plan campaign structures, audience strategy, creatives, messaging, placements and budgets.
* Define relevant KPIs and benchmarks before campaign launch.
* Develop full-funnel strategies across awareness, consideration, lead generation, conversion and remarketing, wherever relevant.

**2.**
**Campaign Execution**

* Independently set up, launch and manage campaigns across
  **Meta Ads and Google Ads**
  .
* Manage campaign objectives, targeting, placements, budgets, bidding, ad sets/ad groups and creatives.
* Set up and monitor conversion events, pixels/tags and other relevant tracking requirements.
* Coordinate with creative and content teams to ensure campaigns have the right assets and messaging.
* Conduct campaign launches, checks and troubleshooting independently.

**3. Campaign Optimization**

* Monitor campaigns regularly and identify performance trends, anomalies and opportunities.
* Optimize campaigns based on
  **CPL, CPA, ROAS, CTR, CPC, CPM, conversion rate and other relevant metrics**
  .
* Conduct audience, creative, placement, budget and bidding optimization.
* Run structured A/B tests and document learnings.
* Identify underperforming campaigns and take corrective action instead of simply increasing or decreasing budgets.
* Scale campaigns when performance and business economics support it.

**4. Tracking & Analytics**

* Understand campaign tracking, conversion tracking and attribution fundamentals.
* Work with tools such as
  **GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel/Events Manager and UTM tracking**
  .
* Analyse user journeys and conversion funnels to identify drop-offs.
* Ensure campaign data is reliable before drawing performance conclusions.

**5. Reporting & Insights**

* Prepare regular performance reports and dashboards.
* Go beyond reporting numbers to explain
  **why performance changed and what should be done next**
  .
* Present campaign performance, key learnings, challenges and optimization recommendations to internal teams and clients.
* Connect advertising metrics with actual business outcomes such as qualified leads, sales, revenue and customer acquisition cost.

**6. Client & Team Collaboration**

* Communicate campaign strategy, performance and recommendations clearly to clients.

**Customer Coverage**

title: Account Manager
description:
Ways of Working - Office / Field: Employees are expected to work from the office on all days out of their respective base locations.

**About the Team -**

Swiggy Dineout is building India’s largest dining out platform that processes more than 100M diners for its partner restaurants across its network for 21000 restaurants in 34 cities and growing. We are striving to augment our consumer promise of enabling unparalleled convenience by helping diners explore restaurants across all categories - from QSRs, cafes, casual dining, premium, fine dining and more and

offer the widest range of offers on restaurant bills through easy payments on the app. We are on a

mission to change the way India dines out. If you are a foodie and equally passionate to redefine the experience of dining out, join our team to be a part of the Swiggy ride!

Dineout is present in 34 cities across India and we have partnerships with more than 21,000 restaurant partners where users can save up to 40% on their dining bills when they pay their restaurant bills using the dine out feature on the Swiggy app.

**Role Summary -**

The role holder is expected to onboard and build relationships with 70-80 partner accounts in the given territory to grow the Dine-out business and service offerings and generate 80-90 lacs Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) per month.

The exact number of partners and revenue targets will be based on the India 1 and India 2 markets and specific geographies assigned

**Responsibilities -**

Account & Partner Relationship Management

Onboard new accounts by explaining the requirements to the partners and coordinating with

internal stakeholders

Meet the existing partners periodically and ensure Restaurant Display Page(RDP) content is

correct and image coverage is high

Make persuasive presentations on the benefits and goodness of Dine Out plans & promotions for

month-on-month growth and ensure partners invest consistently.

Execute growth forward activities such as offer alignments, marketing operations alignments, etc.

to ensure go live on events and activities as planned.

Resolve issues such as 'diner denied payout' and ensure seamless transactions for customers

and partners at the restaurants

Prepare the growth plans for each account being managed and gather competitor action insights.

Data Interpretation & Business Performance Management:

Filter relevant data from the Restaurant facing dashboard and explain the key performance

metrics to the partner

Seek necessary support or actions from the partner to ensure the right RDP view to enable

conversions and grow the business.

Stay updated on the partner's investment in competition through observations at the point of sale,

conversations with the partner and competition sales teams, delivery persons, etc.Ensure partner investments are equal or higher than competition with respect to discounts,

commissions, and advertisements by highlighting relevant inferences from the dashboard and

explaining the gains/benefits to the partner.

Interaction with Stakeholders:

Interact with partner support (discount change, Restaurant Display page, etc.), sales operations

(competition comparison data, or any ongoing festival data, etc.), and finance team (

reconciliation of payouts, queries on GST, etc, amount not credited to partner accounts, etc.).

**Functional Competencies**

Understand Dine Out offerings and gain clarity of growth levers.

Knowledge of basic metrics such as operating hours of restaurants , ADs revenue per order (Ads

RPO) , Commission Revenue per order and its constituents such as Average Order Value (AOV)

Elements of data dashboards such as CMS/ PowerBi/Compass/Salesmate

Understanding of Conversion Funnel - Advanced Level Week Wise /Month Wise/Day Wise

transactions across accounts , denial rates, supply metrics vs competition

**Desired Skills -**

Graduate with 1.5-3 year of field sales experience; Fluency in local language and working

knowledge of English

Good working knowledge and experience of e-commerce activities and all online marketing

channels

Confident, Pleasing, and a go-getter personality

Effective communication skills

Attitude & Aptitude for Sales

Should be a team player, working alongside people from all walks of life.

Analytical, good Excel skills.

The candidate has to be flexible, restaurant owners do not operate on 9-to-5 schedules

Leadership and Influencing skills: Identify, build, and use a wide network of contacts with people

at all levels, internally and externally. Achieves a good result through a well-planned approach.

Initiative & Flexibility: Recognizes the need to adapt to change & implement appropriate solutions.

Be able to identify opportunities and recommend/influence change to increase the effectiveness

and success of campaigns.

Creativity & Initiative: Demonstrate creativity & originality in your work and have the personal

drive and initiative to bring about change and help drive the business forward.

title: Premier Service Manager
description:

The Premier Service Manager (PSM) role is a pivotal position within the International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) branch network. **Other Requirements (Knowledge And Experience)**

* Well-organized with a professional image and extraordinary business focus.
* Strong customer orientation and ability to provide exemplary service.
* Self-motivated with the drive to overachieve on goals and targets.
* Ability to build close relationships with team members and skillful association with support group colleagues.

* Strong Interpersonal Skills: Capable of building and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues and clients.

* Collaborative Team Player: Works well within a team, contributing to collective goals and fostering a supportive environment.
* Proactive and Efficient: Acts swiftly and decisively to achieve objectives, ensuring timely completion of tasks.

FEDAI, NISM (Demat), and IRDA certifications are preferred or should be obtained / transferred to HSBC mapping within 3 to 6 months of onboarding.
  
  
**Additional Notes**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
  
  
Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

description:

* Ensure timely customer communication for machine installation activities and site-readiness requirements.
* Support customers with mould trials, both in-house and at customer sites, to enable machine shipment and successful commissioning.
* Visit customers regularly to maintain strong liaison, address service needs and support repeat business.

**Revenue, Collections & Aftermarket Growth**

* Plan and achieve territorial service revenue and aftermarket sales revenue targets in the domestic market.
* Generate aftermarket business through service opportunities, spare-parts requirements and customer support interventions.
* Coordinate and follow up for collection of outstanding payments related to spare parts.
* Identify customer requirements and service opportunities that can strengthen long-term aftermarket revenue.

**Technical Improvement & Product Feedback**

* Gather structured information on product performance and recurring machine issues.
* Develop and implement corrective and preventive actions for machine-related concerns, and support deployment of actions across applicable machines.
* Coordinate with internal departments to resolve recurring issues in existing machines and provide recommendations for modifications or customisation.
* Visit mould vendors as required for validation activities.

**Market Intelligence & Cross-functional Coordination**

* Conduct competitor analysis and share relevant insights to support future business and service strategy.
* Manage key international customers for product troubleshooting or support requirements, where assigned.
* Collaborate with service, sales, engineering, manufacturing and other internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer concerns.

**Reporting & Governance**

* Prepare service data, management information reports and required operational records.
* Ensure accurate and timely data entry in the ERP system.
* Maintain visibility of customer issues, corrective actions, revenue opportunities and pending follow-ups.

**SUCCESS METRICS / KPIS**
**Revenue & Customer Outcomes**
**Service & Technical Delivery**
**Operational Discipline**

* Service revenue vs. target
* Aftermarket sales revenue vs. target
* Outstanding spare-parts payment collection
* Repeat customer and retention outcomes
* Machine uptime and breakdown resolution
* Installation and site-readiness effectiveness
* Closure of corrective / preventive actions
* Customer issue resolution and escalation closure
* Accuracy and timeliness of ERP / MIS data
* On-time reporting and follow-up closure
* Customer visit and coverage discipline
* Cross-functional action closure

**Key Skill Requirements**
**Skill Dimension**
**What We Are Looking For**
**Technical & Service**

* Strong knowledge of injection moulding machines, installation, troubleshooting and breakdown support
* Understanding of mould trials, processing issues, preventive actions and spare-parts support
* Ability to translate recurring field issues into practical technical improvement actions

**Commercial & Customer**

* Service revenue planning and aftermarket business development
* Customer relationship management, escalation handling and payment follow-up
* Ability to identify service-led sales opportunities and support repeat business

**Analytics & Governance**

* Competitor and product-performance analysis
* Proficiency in MIS reporting, ERP data entry and follow-up tracking
* Structured approach to corrective / preventive action governance

**Leadership & Behavioural**

* Team leadership and cross-functional coordination
* Customer-first mindset with ownership and urgency
* Strong communication, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills

**Experience Profile**

* 15 years of relevant experience in service management, customer support or aftermarket operations for industrial equipment / capital goods.
* Bachelor of Engineering / Technology in Electronics & Instrumentation, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering; or Diploma in Electronics, Electrical & Communication, Mechanical or Mechatronics Engineering.
* Demonstrated experience in leading service teams, managing customer escalations and delivering revenue targets.
* Experience in injection moulding machinery, machine installation, troubleshooting, mould trials and aftermarket support is preferred.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems, MIS reporting and cross-functional service governance.

the product.

title: Store Manager
description:
**Job Description**

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
**​**
  
As a Store Manager, you’ll oversee the entire customer experience, ensuring high visual and commercial standards that align with global strategies and your store’s local context. Acting in line with our values, you’ll drive both your success and the company’s success.

You will:

* Lead your store team to deliver an outstanding customer experience while promoting and selling our products.
* Stay informed about your store’s strengths, opportunities, and competitors, with a strong understanding of the local market and customer needs.
* Analyse sales performance, set goals, and create plans to optimize results, profits, and stock levels.
* Manage scheduling and store maintenance efficiently, aligning with sales budgets and commercial priorities.
* Recruit, onboard, and develop your team while fostering an inclusive and collaborative culture that promotes growth and innovation.
* Stay updated on fashion trends, customer preferences, and competitors to maintain a competitive edge.
* Represent yourself and the brand positively during all customer interactions.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH​**

Our stores are the heart of our company, where customers experience our brand firsthand. As part of the dynamic Store Team, every role—from Sales Advisors, Department Managers, Store Managers and Visual Merchandisers to Assistant Store Managers, Cash Office Responsible, and Delivery Responsible in larger stores—contributes to creating an inspiring and welcoming environment. You’ll also connect with the wider Area Team, collaborating across stores to share insights and drive success together. Alongside your team, you'll play a vital role in helping customers feel confident and express their individuality with the latest trends and timeless styles. By building meaningful connections with customers in our stores, we make fashion accessible and sustainable for all.​

**WHO YOU ARE​**

*We are looking for people with…*
​

* Experience in retail management and operations.

* A proven track record of strong leadership, with a passion for coaching and developing teams while exemplifying company values and culture.
* Proven results using customer centric reporting and tools.
* Expertise in sales planning, analysis, and follow-up.

*And people who are…*
​

* Strong and confident leaders who inspire, coach, and develop their teams with integrity.
* Motivated to create great customers experiences while promoting and driving sales.
* Ambitious and motivated by performance, competition, and achieving goals.
* Analytical problem-solvers with excellent communication skills and a knack for working with numbers and statistics.
* Flexible and solution oriented.
* Passionate about fashion trends, commerciality, and visual presentation, with a keen awareness of competitors.

**WHO WE ARE​**

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

​We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​

​
**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE ​**
  
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​

* We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability.
* We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years.
* We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work
* You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits.
* We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness for self and family.
* You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M group.
* We offer 5 days of working in a week to have great work life balance.

**JOIN US​**

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

​Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

*\*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.*

​

**Additional Information**

To manage the high volume of applications for roles with leadership responsibilities, we use an online assessment method. You will need to complete it as part of the application and screening process. Your responses will be scored by an assessment tool that applies to predefined criteria set by H&M Group.

After completing the assessment, you’ll have the opportunity to share feedback and ask questions.

If you experience any difficulties or prefer an alternative assessment method, please contact recruitment\_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative will not impact your application. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice.
