title: Partner Account Executive - North & East
description:
**Partner Account Executive – North & East India**
**Role Summary**
As a Partner Account Executive, you will own and grow strategic business relationships with Cisco’s Growth Partners across the North & East India region.
  
  
You will serve as a trusted advisor to partner leadership, developing joint business strategies that strengthen partner capabilities, accelerate Cisco adoption, create new market opportunities, and drive sustainable year-over-year revenue growth.
  
  
Working closely with Cisco Sales, Systems Engineering, Portfolio and Specialist teams, you will orchestrate partner ecosystems and execute differentiated go-to-market strategies that expand Cisco’s footprint and strengthen partner profitability.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own and grow a portfolio of Growth Partners across North & East India, building trusted relationships across partner leadership, sales, technical and business teams.
* Develop and execute joint partner business plans aligned to Cisco’s strategic priorities, partner capabilities, customer needs and revenue objectives.
* Drive year-over-year partner revenue growth by identifying new opportunities, expanding Cisco solution adoption and increasing partner preference for Cisco.
* Develop partner capabilities and practices across key technology areas, enabling partners to build differentiated offerings and go-to-market motions.
* Identify market trends, customer needs and competitive insights to shape partner strategies and position Cisco effectively within the partner ecosystem.
* Create and execute joint go-to-market and demand-generation initiatives that generate pipeline and accelerate partner-led sales.
* Enable partners through Cisco programs, incentives, investments, training and resources to strengthen their sales and technical capabilities.
* Orchestrate Cisco Sales, Systems Engineering, Portfolio and Specialist teams to support partner readiness, solution development, co-sell opportunities and customer engagement.
* Advocate for partner priorities internally and ensure partner capabilities are incorporated into relevant account and territory strategies.
* Monitor partner performance through business reviews, pipeline, revenue and profitability metrics, identifying opportunities for optimization and growth.
* Lead regular business reviews and performance planning with partners, using data and market insights to drive continuous improvement.
* Build strong competitive awareness and help partners differentiate Cisco solutions within their respective markets.

**Who You’ll Work With**
You will work across a highly collaborative ecosystem including:
  
  

* Partner leadership and sales/technical teams
* Cisco Account Executives and Sales Leaders
* Systems Engineers and Solution Specialists
* Portfolio and Practice Sellers
* Marketing and Partner Enablement teams
* Regional and Business Entity leadership

**Who You Are**
You are a commercially driven partner/channel sales professional who understands how technology partners build businesses and how vendors can jointly create growth.
  
  
You are comfortable operating with senior partner stakeholders, developing business strategies, influencing without authority and bringing together multiple teams to execute against shared goals.
  
  
You combine strong relationship management with a
**growth mindset, business acumen and the ability to turn partner capabilities into revenue opportunities.**
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of relevant experience in Channel Sales, Partner Sales, Alliances or related IT sales roles.
* Strong understanding of indirect sales models and the India IT partner ecosystem.
* Demonstrated experience managing partner portfolios and driving revenue growth.
* Experience developing joint business plans and go-to-market strategies with technology partners.
* Proven ability to influence partner leadership and collaborate across internal and external teams.
* Strong executive presence, communication, negotiation and business-development skills.
* Willingness to travel across the assigned region as required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with Systems Integrators, Resellers, Distributors, Managed Service Providers or other technology partners.
* Experience across networking, cybersecurity, cloud, SaaS or related technology solutions.
* Knowledge of Cisco solutions, partner programs and incentive structures.
* Existing understanding of the North & East India partner ecosystem.
* Experience developing new partner practices, capabilities or GTM motions.
* Strong analytical skills with experience using business performance and pipeline data to drive decisions.
* Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Business or a related field.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.

title: Customer Manager, Building & Infrastructure
description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
  
  
Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple - to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**About You And This Role**
As a
**Customer Manager**
, based in
**Kolkata, India**
, you will be a dynamic and self-motivated commercial professional who combines strategic thinking with disciplined execution to drive profitable growth. In this role, you will lead the
**Building & Infrastructure**
business across
**Eastern India and Bangladesh**
, with responsibility for key market segments including
**Projects, Retail, Construction Chemicals, and other strategic growth areas**
.
  
  
You will be responsible for developing and executing growth strategies, identifying and converting new business opportunities, strengthening strategic customer relationships, and expanding Dow’s route-to-market network. This includes working closely with distributors, dealers, retailers, hardware stores, contractors, applicators, and other key industry stakeholders. You will be equally effective in engaging customers at the point of sale, influencing project stakeholders, and presenting market insights, business strategies, and growth recommendations to senior leadership.
  
  
Success in this role requires the ability to combine customer insights, channel development expertise, project specification influence, value-based selling, and cross-functional collaboration to accelerate market penetration and drive sustainable business growth. Your ability to translate market trends and customer needs into actionable commercial strategies will be instrumental in strengthening Dow’s market position and delivering long-term business success.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute growth strategies for the Building & Infrastructure business across Eastern India and Bangladesh, with a strong focus on Projects, Retail, Construction Chemicals, and other designated market segments.
* Expand and strengthen the retail route-to-market by developing high-performing networks of distributors, dealers, retailers, hardware stores, contractors, applicators, and other channel partners to maximize market reach and customer adoption.
* Build and maintain strategic relationships with developers, architects, consultants, contractors, fabricators, and other key decision-makers to influence specifications and secure project opportunities.
* Identify, qualify, and convert new business opportunities while maintaining a robust sales pipeline, accurate forecasts, and disciplined opportunity management from inception through closure.
* Drive value-based selling initiatives, commercial negotiations, pricing strategies, and joint business plans that contribute to revenue growth, margin expansion, customer retention, and channel excellence.
* Collaborate closely with Marketing, Product Management, Technical Service, Supply Chain, and Customer Service teams to deliver customer value while providing market intelligence, competitive insights, and business updates to senior stakeholders.

**Qualifications**
To be successful in this role, you should possess:
  
  

* A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Architecture, Business, or a related field from a recognized institution. An MBA or Master's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, or a related discipline is preferred.
* 10-12 years of experience in sales, business development, account management, project sales, channel development, market development, or related commercial roles.
* Proven experience serving customers within the Building & Infrastructure, Construction Chemicals, Building Materials, Architectural Solutions, or related industries.
* Demonstrated success in developing and growing markets through distributors, dealers, retailers, hardware stores, contractors, applicators, and similar channel partners across geographically diverse regions.
* Experience managing strategic accounts, major projects, and specification-driven opportunities while influencing a broad range of stakeholders involved in purchasing decisions.
* A proven track record of independently developing markets, converting opportunities into sustainable business growth, and presenting business strategies and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively across Eastern India and Bangladesh.

**Your Skills**

* Market development and growth strategy, with the ability to transform customer, channel, and competitive insights into executable business plans.
* Channel and retail development, including distributor management, dealer expansion, outlet penetration, and demand generation.
* Strategic account and project management, including stakeholder mapping, specification influence, and opportunity conversion.
* Value-based selling, commercial negotiations, and development of differentiated solutions that create customer value.
* Business planning and commercial analytics, including sales forecasting, pipeline management, performance tracking, and corrective action planning.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to effectively present business strategies, market intelligence, and growth recommendations.

**Additional Notes**

* This position supports market development activities across Eastern India and Bangladesh.
* The business portfolio includes Projects, Retail, Construction Chemicals, and other designated Building & Infrastructure market segments.
* Extensive travel is required to develop customer relationships, strengthen channel networks, support project opportunities, and identify new areas for business growth.
* Relocation support is not available for this position.

**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
We invest in you.
  
  
Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
  
  
Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
  
  

* Equitable and market-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
* Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
* Competitive retirement program that may include company-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial-goals.

+ Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).

description:
**Description**
Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.
  
  
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include--but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development & delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**Requirements**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End-to-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

**Business Development**

Ensuring a growth in wallet share of existing customers and on boarding new customers by offering 360-degree banking solutions that meet the needs of our customers.

**Champion 360-degree banking**

Offer products based on customer needs in collaboration with other internal teams in the bank for suitable product offerings.

**Enhance the portfolio quality**

Work towards enhancing customer portfolio within the philosophy of Fair to Bank, Fair to Customer.

**Customised solutions**

As per branch guidelines. Upkeep and maintaining of the branch. Ensure availability of necessary infrastructure in the branch.

**Behold our values**

Offer products that are fair to our customers and fair to the bank.

**Qualifications & Skills**

MBA/PGDM with 2 years of experience/Graduates with 6 years in the area of relationship management, Business development or allied roles.

**Synergize with Team**

Willingness to work with various teams for on-ground support and deliver enablers as required.

**Improvise**

Develop and implement overarching sales and customer relationship strategy, sales processes and structure.

**Market Sensing**

Monitor and evaluate industry trends, customer drivers and potential partnerships

**Communication**

Good oral and written communication skills.

**About the Business group**

ICICI Bank’s Private Banking Group (PBG) offers comprehensive investment solutions and services to high net worth individuals and Family offices across India and international geographies. We emphasize on our high quality investment management services along with leading banking and allied group capabilities.

Fulfilling the investment needs and aspirations of our clients is our constant endeavour. After extensive in-house research, the group’s handpicked product offerings help our customers achieve their goals. With the team of experts, group reviews various assets classes along with market and economic conditions to produce incisive insights. These house views, along with rigorous due diligence, help our team of Relationship Managers to suggest a range of products across asset classes. As the financial goals are unique, group creates a tailor-made investment strategy according to the needs of the customers. This is done based on a thorough understanding of financial needs and keeping customers’ investment attitude in mind. The group also offers advisory on Trust Services and Succession Planning. Family Office proposition aims to strengthen the governance structure in family owned businesses.

Thus, emphasis is on a holistic approach towards financial and business goals. The strategic collaboration with global product providers enables us to construct unique solutions. It allows us to complement our core competencies with world class, third party capabilities to deliver solutions to customer's specific needs.

# Seeking Co-Founder & Strategic Business Partner | ₹10 Lakhs+ Investment | Healthcare, Education & Technology

Our medical-related YouTube channels, providing opportunities to develop healthcare education content and explore future monetisation.

We plan to build a broader healthcare services, education and technology business through four major areas:
  
  
\*\*1. Dental Business Consulting\*\*
  
  
Help dentists establish, manage and grow their clinics through practical business consultancy and customised growth planning.
  
  
\*\*2. Global Dental Training & Education\*\*
  
  
Build DentistUpgrade.com into a global platform offering hands-on training, online courses and professional learning opportunities for dentists.
  
  
\*\*3. Healthcare Digital Marketing Agency\*\*
  
  
Provide specialised digital marketing, lead generation and patient acquisition services to dentists, clinics and other healthcare service providers.

Our initial focus will be on dentists, with plans to expand into other healthcare services as we validate demand and build our capabilities.

\*\*Key requirements:\*\*

\* Strong experience in sales, marketing, business development or entrepreneurship.
  
\* Ability to develop customer acquisition strategies and generate paying customers.

\* Ability to develop strategic partnerships with dentists, training providers, clinics and healthcare organisations.

\* Acquire our first paying customers and establish repeatable revenue channels.
  
\* Build partnerships for dental training, education and healthcare services.
  
\* Develop revenue models for our existing websites and digital assets.

I bring \*\*12+ years of dental experience and experience owning two dental clinics\*\*, along with existing websites, digital platforms and healthcare-related media assets.
  
  
We have a foundation to build upon, and our current priority is to convert existing website traffic into paying customers, validate our business models and develop our future services progressively.
  
  
\*\*Please note:\*\* We are currently at an early stage of monetisation and are not yet generating revenue from these ventures. Our future initiatives will depend on market validation, investment and execution.

title: Sales Development Representative – GCC
description:
Sales Development Representative – Global Capability Centres (GCC)

**Company:**
Opvia

**Employment:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
2–5 years in B2B sales development, preferably targeting international markets

About Opvia

Opvia positions itself as a
**Global Capability Centre (GCC) partner for startups**
, helping growing businesses build dedicated, full-time teams in India without setting up and managing their own local entity.

We handle recruitment, infrastructure, payroll, HR, compliance and day-to-day operational support. Each employee works exclusively for one client, becoming an extension of their team across functions such as marketing, finance, operations, customer support and technology.

About the Role

We’re looking for a proactive Sales Development Representative to identify and engage startups and growing businesses looking to expand their teams.

You’ll connect with founders and senior decision-makers, understand their hiring and growth challenges, and introduce Opvia’s model of building a dedicated GCC in India. Your primary responsibility will be to generate qualified opportunities and book discovery calls for the founders.

Key Responsibilities

* Research and identify startups that could benefit from building dedicated teams in India.
* Connect with founders, CEOs, COOs and functional leaders through cold calling, email and LinkedIn.
* Explain Opvia’s GCC model clearly, covering dedicated talent, operational support, cost efficiency and scalability.
* Qualify prospects based on hiring needs, budgets, decision-making authority and timelines.
* Book qualified discovery meetings and provide clear notes ahead of each call.
* Build and maintain a consistent pipeline through personalised outreach and structured follow-ups.
* Keep contact records, conversations and next steps updated in the CRM.
* Work closely with the founders to improve targeting, messaging and objection handling.
* Track outreach activity, responses, meetings booked and opportunities generated.

What We’re Looking For

* 2–5 years of experience in B2B sales development or outbound business development.
* Experience prospecting into international markets, particularly the UK, US or other English-speaking markets.
* Strong spoken and written English, with confidence speaking to founders and senior leaders.
* Comfortable making cold calls and managing multichannel outreach.
* Ability to understand business needs and sell a consultative service.
* Experience using CRM systems, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and outbound prospecting tools.
* Strong follow-up discipline, ownership and attention to detail.

Experience selling GCC services, offshore staffing, recruitment, employer-of-record services or other business services to startups would be an advantage.

What Success Looks Like

* A steady flow of qualified meetings with relevant decision-makers.
* A well-maintained pipeline with clear next steps.
* Prospects who understand how Opvia can support their growth through a dedicated team in India.
* Opportunities that progress from introductory conversations to client partnerships.

title: Partnerships & Activations Lead
description:
**Job Title: Partnerships & Activations Lead**

**Location:**
Kolkata

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, work from office, with local travel

**Preferred Experience:**
3–5 years in partnerships, community marketing, retail marketing, brand activations or business development

**About Sevora**

Sevora is a stylist-led fashion shopping platform offering curated fashion, personal shopping assistance, Try at Home and express delivery in eligible locations. We help customers discover and purchase outfits with confidence and convenience.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a relationship-driven professional to build partnerships and deliver community activations that generate qualified leads, shopping appointments and sales.

You will develop a network across Kolkata’s residential communities, clubs, private social groups and complementary businesses. Working closely with Sales and the Personal Shopper, you will own partner acquisition, activation planning, execution, lead quality and cost efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Partnerships & Community Development**

* Build relationships with community hosts, residential associations, premium clubs, women’s groups and event organisers.
* Establish referral partnerships with salons, beauty studios, wedding planners, makeup artists and complementary lifestyle businesses.
* Develop partnership proposals and negotiate participation fees, promotional support, collaboration terms and referral arrangements.
* Maintain an active partner pipeline and monthly activation calendar.
* Develop productive partnerships into recurring shopping events and referral opportunities.

**2. Lead Generation & Appointment Booking**

* Deliver monthly targets for qualified customer leads and shopping appointments.
* Generate enquiries through kitty parties, private gatherings, residential communities, clubs, curated exhibitions, professional networks and referrals.
* Prepare channel plans with target audiences, activities, budgets and expected outcomes.
* Capture shopping preferences, budget, occasion, buying timeline and location to support lead qualification.
* Develop customer and community-host referral programmes with approved incentives and clear tracking.

**3. Activations & Event Execution**

* Plan and execute private shopping sessions, styling events, collection previews, pop-ups and community activations.
* Evaluate opportunities based on audience fit, purchase intent, participation costs and sales potential.
* Own event logistics, including permissions, venue arrangements, setup, displays, staffing coordination and partner communication.
* Coordinate invitations, lookbooks, QR codes, registration forms and promotional materials with Marketing and Creative teams.
* Coordinate assortment, stock availability, product movement and reconciliation with Merchandising and Operations.
* Work with Sales and the Personal Shopper to deliver shopping assistance and introduce eligible customers to Try at Home.
* Manage approved budgets and maintain records of expenses and partner commitments.

**4. Lead Handover & Sales Coordination**

* Capture accurate customer details and permission for follow-up.
* Record lead source, preferences, interest level and next action in the CRM.
* Hand over leads promptly to Sales with clear ownership and follow-up expectations.
* Review appointment attendance, follow-up progress, purchases and reasons for lost sales.
* Coordinate post-event follow-ups with Sales and retention campaigns with CRM.
* Use customer and sales feedback to improve future activations.

**5. Performance & Reporting**

* Report weekly on partner outreach, confirmed activities, qualified leads, appointments, costs and attributable sales.
* Track performance by partner, event and referral source using CRM tags, QR links or referral codes.
* Monitor cost per qualified lead, cost per purchasing customer and sales after cancellations and returns.
* Assess activation profitability with Finance using product margins and relevant costs.
* Recommend which partnerships and activities to expand, improve or discontinue.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Relevant experience in partnerships, community marketing, retail marketing, activations or business development.
* Strong networking, negotiation, presentation and relationship-management skills.
* Experience generating customer leads and delivering measurable commercial outcomes.
* Ability to manage activities independently, from outreach and planning to execution and reporting.
* Understanding of budgets, lead qualification, conversion and customer acquisition costs.
* Clear communication in Bengali, Hindi and English.
* Comfort using spreadsheets, presentations, WhatsApp Business and CRM tools.
* Willingness to travel within Kolkata and support scheduled evening or weekend events.

**Preferred Background**

Experience in fashion, premium retail, beauty, hospitality or lifestyle services. Existing relationships with Kolkata communities, clubs, residential associations and relevant businesses will be an advantage.

title: EVENTS & MEMBERS COORDINATOR - AUSTRALIAN CHAMBER OF COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY (ACCI)
description:
T
**he Australian Chamber of Commerce and Industry (ACCI)**
is the voice of Australian business—representing hundreds of thousands of organisations across every industry and state. From SMEs to major corporates, ACCI plays a critical role in shaping the policy settings that drive economic growth, job creation, and prosperity.
  
  
At the centre of national debate, ACCI advocates directly to government, regulators and international bodies to ensure Australia remains one of the best places in the world to do business.
  
  
Through its member network, events program and stakeholder engagement, ACCI connects business leaders, policymakers and industry representatives to share insights, strengthen relationships and support practical outcomes for Australian employers.
  
  
**About The Role**
This is a hands-on coordination opportunity at the intersection of member engagement, events delivery and national business advocacy.
  
  
As Membership and Events Coordinator, you will support ACCI’s strategic priorities for member retention and growth by coordinating member services, stakeholder engagement initiatives and a national program of professional events.
  
  
Sitting within a collaborative national team, you will blend membership engagement and events coordination—supporting onboarding, renewals and partner fulfilment while helping deliver high-quality forums, roundtables, webinars, briefings and major business events. You will also assist with related marketing, communications, data and administrative activities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**
*Membership Engagement*

* Assist in the development and delivery of membership growth, retention and engagement initiatives across ACCI’s national network.
* Coordinate member onboarding, renewals, membership communications and ongoing engagement activities.
* Provide professional, timely and service-oriented support to members, prospective members and other stakeholders, responding to enquiries and facilitating access to ACCI benefits and services.
* Maintain accurate membership records, contact details, engagement information and member activity data within ACCI’s database systems.
* Assist in monitoring member engagement and preparing membership reports, insights and retention activities.
* Contribute ideas and practical support to enhance member experience, satisfaction and value.
* Support sponsorship and partner fulfilment activities, including coordinating partner benefits, stakeholder communications, branding requirements and deliverables.

*Events Coordination*

* Support the planning of ACCI events, including forums, roundtables, webinars, member briefings, stakeholder functions and major business events.
* Coordinate event logistics, including venue liaison, catering, audiovisual requirements, speaker coordination and event run sheets.
* Manage event registrations and attendee administration, including invitations, guest lists, RSVP tracking, event communications and registration reporting.
* Provide professional and responsive customer service to event attendees before, during and after events.
* Support on-site event delivery, ensuring a high-quality experience for members, sponsors, speakers, partners and guests.
* Liaise with suppliers, contractors and service providers to ensure successful event execution.
* Maintain event records, attendee data, feedback and post-event reporting.Assist with the development of event collateral, including invitations, programs, presentations, signage and briefing materials.

*Administration*

* Support marketing campaigns that promote ACCI events, membership, advocacy initiatives and stakeholder engagement activities.
* Assist with the creation and distribution of communications and marketing materials, including newsletters, website content, social media posts and promotional collateral.
* Assist with analysing membership, event and marketing data to identify trends, opportunities and areas for improvement.
* Contribute ideas and practical support to enhance communications effectiveness, stakeholder engagement and operational processes.
* Work collaboratively across the ACCI team and undertake general administrative and coordination duties as required.
* Provide other support as directed by the Head of Partnerships and Growth and the Director of Strategic Events.

This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a national organisation at the centre of business advocacy while building experience across membership engagement, events, sponsorship support, stakeholder service, communications and data management.
  
  
**The Successful Applicant**
You are a highly organised, practical and service-oriented coordinator who enjoys bringing people, details, content and deadlines together. You are comfortable working in a busy environment, confident communicating with a wide range of stakeholders and motivated by the opportunity to support high-quality member engagement, events, marketing activity and communications.
  
  
**You Will Bring**

* Experience in events, membership, stakeholder engagement, marketing, communications, administration or a related coordination role.
* Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate professionally with members, senior stakeholders, suppliers and colleagues.
* High attention to detail across records, registrations, communications, marketing materials, event collateral and member information.
* Sound digital capability, including proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 and confidence using CRM, database, online registration, email marketing, social media or webinar platforms.
* The ability to prepare accurate, engaging and audience-appropriate content for newsletters, websites, social media, briefings and member communications.
* Comfort working with data and records, with the ability to maintain accurate information and identify basic trends, opportunities or areas for improvement.
* A collaborative, positive and proactive approach, with sound judgement and a willingness to contribute across a small, high-performing team.
* The ability to work calmly under pressure and provide practical support during busy event, campaign or membership periods.

**Highly Desirable**

* Experience in a membership-based organisation, business association, not-for-profit, peak body or professional services environment.
* Experience supporting business events, conferences, forums, webinars, stakeholder briefings or member engagement programs.
* Familiarity with association management systems, CRM platforms, event registration tools, email marketing platforms, website content management systems or social media scheduling tools.
* Experience assisting with marketing campaigns, newsletters, digital content or social media for an organisation with multiple stakeholder audiences.
* You are energised by the opportunity to support events, member engagement and communications that connect Australian businesses with the people, ideas and policy discussions shaping the national agenda.

What’s on Offer
  
  
A unique opportunity to support events, membership engagement, marketing and communications activity for Australia’s peak business organisation.
  
  
Direct engagement with members, industry stakeholders, government representatives and national partners.
  
  
A varied coordination role across events, membership, content creation, data management, communications and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
The opportunity to contribute to professional events, campaigns and member initiatives with national visibility and real impact.
  
  
A collaborative and high-performing team environment based in Canberra.
  
  
**How To Apply**
All applications should be
**submitted to info@acci.com.au**
with the following documents:
  
  
Cover letter
  
  
Resume/CV
  
  
We welcome and encourage applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, people with disability, LGBTQIA+ people, and people from culturally diverse backgrounds.
  
  
***Applications close 5:00 pm Wednesday, 21 October 2026.***
Early applications are advised as ACCI reserves the right to close the vacancy early if suitable applications are received.

title: Outbound Lead Development Representative - International
description:
**About Duratuf**

We're an industrial safety company in Kolkata, with our own office and warehouse in Dubai

Our equipment keeps workers safe at 4,142+ customers across 65+ countries — when it works, someone gets to go home to their family.

We're on our way to 10,000 protected workplaces by 2035

**About the Role**

* Demand generation engine of our international outbound motion, covering UAE, India, APAC, Europe, GCC and the Americas
* Research target companies in our focus industries and develop interest into sales-ready opportunities
* Move each contact from Prospect (MQL) to a sales-qualified lead (SQL) that Sales accepts, with a meeting on the calendar
* Full-cycle prospecting seat: you own the bridge into Sales, you do not negotiate or close, and you carry no pricing authority
* Fully digital and desk-based, with no field visits

**Research and Target**

* Identify and research target companies across all markets against the defined ideal customer profile (ICP)
* Build and maintain target account lists by market
* Map the decision-makers and buying committee in each account

**Enrich and Maintain Data**

* Source and validate contact information using approved tools
* Keep every prospect record in CRM accurate, complete and up to date, tagged by market

**Pitch and Develop**

* Reach out by email, LinkedIn, phone and WhatsApp (where applicable)
* Personalise every message to the account and its market, and follow the defined sequences and cadences
* Open real conversations with plant, EHS, safety and procurement buyers

**Qualify MQL to SQL**

* Run a structured qualification against the criteria set by management and Sales for each market
* Capture buying signals and make an honest qualify or reject call on every lead
* Understand each account's scope and potential

**Fix the Meeting**

* Secure a genuine meeting or next step with Sales across time zones and hand over cleanly
* Move real opportunities forward, not just pricing requests

**Build Qualified Pipeline**

* Develop and maintain a qualified pipeline for Sales, with clear opportunity value by market

**Keep the CRM Honest**

* Log every contact, activity, disposition and stage in CRM in real time

**Feed the Loop**

* Track outreach and conversion metrics by market and join the weekly performance review
* Share learnings back to demand generation and Sales so targeting and criteria keep getting sharper

**How Success Is Measured**

* MQL to SQL qualification against the agreed criteria for each market
* SQL acceptance by Sales: a meeting fixed and taken forward, not just a request for pricing
* Pipeline value handed to Sales (for example, USD pipeline developed)
* GP contribution from qualified opportunities that convert into orders

**Requirements**

**Qualifications**

* Experience: 2-4 years in B2B lead generation, inside sales, presales, SDR / LDR or outbound business development
* Comfortable owning a daily qualification and calling number
* Hands-on outbound experience (required): reached out to business prospects, run discovery and qualified them
* Strong internet research skills; ideally has researched accounts on LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo or similar

**Technical Skills**

* CRM familiarity (required), ideally Zoho CRM, with clean dispositions and stages
* Qualifies with a method (BANT / CHAMP / SPIN or similar), not gut feel
* Can read an account's scope and potential
* Plus: tools such as Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot or Lusha

**Functional Skills**

* Strong communicator with international buyers: clear, confident written and spoken English
* Comfortable with plant, EHS, safety and procurement contacts across cultures and time zones
* Gets the meeting: moves a conversation to a fixed next step, not a soft maybe

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to international markets
* Experience in industrial, manufacturing, engineering, SaaS or B2B services
* Exposure to technical / industrial products or PPE

**Application**

* Include a link to your 90-second video introduction (questions are in the application form)

**Benefits**

* Own the gate: the call on what is a real opportunity and what is noise is yours
* Learn B2B selling properly: real discovery with real buyers and a real method
* A mission that matters: every account you qualify moves a real plant closer to safe
* Fully remote within India, or office-based at Kolkata HQ (South City Business Park, Anandapur)
* Working hours aligned to the time zones of your assigned markets, agreed at offer stage
* Everything runs on Zoho One

* Monitor e-procurement portal portals and client websites for relevant tender notices — IoT, CAAQMS, environmental monitoring, smart infrastructure, IIoT sectors
* Liaise with government departments, PSUs, and institutional clients for tender clarifications, corrigendum updates, and bid openings
* Maintain login credentials, DSC (Digital Signature Certificate) renewals, portal registrations, and vendor empanelments
* Coordinate with technical and legal teams to ensure all responses to pre-qualification questionnaires and technical queries are accurate and submitted on time
* Analyse lost tenders for lessons learned and support improvement of future bid strategies
* Maintain a repository of standard tender documents, pre-qualified certifications, and company credentials ready for rapid deployment
* Customer & Sales Operations

* Support contract review by highlighting commercial, technical, and operational aspects
* Maintain CRM, opportunity trackers, and sales dashboards
* Coordinate seamless handover from Sales to Delivery
* Cross-Functional Program Management
* Drive execution across strategic initiatives
* Track deliverables, dependencies, and timelines
* Identify bottlenecks and escalate proactively
* Continuously improve internal coordination processes

**Requirements**

* Good hands-on experience working with Government clients
* Hands-on experience in bidding and government bidding portal/site management
* Experience in preparing deal collateral
* Notice Period: Immediate or shorter notice period preferred
* Language Skills: Bengali fluency is essential; must be fluent in English with strong vocal command for presentations

**Preferred Qualifications**

* B.E. / B.Tech with MBA — Mandatory

The jobholder to ensure that high quality customer service is provided to customers in line with Global Premier Service Standards. The identification of opportunities for wealth reviews and delivering wealth solutions as an adviser are amongst the key activities to achieve your goals as complied with local regulatory requirement.
  
  
All this needs to be achieved by keeping the highest standards of integrity towards the bank and clients and the regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Principal Accountabilities**
**Impact on the Business / Function**

* Maximize profit and achievement of the growth of Premier clients portfolio
* Achieve agreed financial targets by development of existing and new relationships
* Build effective relationships with clients to retain and develop sustainable relationships
* Complete regular reviews with clients to understand their current and long term needs and advise them on the products and services that help them achieve their goals
* Effective use of tools and information to drive client service delivery and performance
* Maintain a minimum standard of qualifying Premier clients within portfolio as stated by Group
* Build a high personal and corporate profile in the community in which you are based. Develop network of Group and External professional contacts with the aim of introducing new business, enhancing technical knowledge and promoting the brand

* Establish and agree client contact strategies in line with Group operating models
* Fully utilize and input to Client Relationship Management data, ensuring all client information is complete and kept up to date

**Customers / Stakeholders**

* Own the client relationship with HSBC

* Maintain highest standard of excellence in client service across the team and with individual portfolio - Ongoing analysis of client portfolios through marketing of ideas and researching clients
* Monitor client satisfaction data implementing portfolio level improvements

* Agree and manage lending facilities within any agreed Approval Authority
* Manage operational risk, by using relevant data to identify risk situations and take any appropriate action to minimize loss
* Adhere to selling process and sales quality requirements
* Comply with the applicable laws, regulations, Group and local guidelines related to Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering policy of HSBC while undertaking various day to day operations
* Remain alert and promptly report to the Sanctions Officer/ Line manager ( As applicable and required by the Anti Money Laundering and sanction Policy) if a customer is found to be engaging in sanction evasion activities or violations of policy or any other related procedures.
* Understand the legal responsibility to be vigilant for unusual activity and reporting of the unusual activities
* Support the Country or Regional Offices / Investigations by providing additional information when required
* Responsible for attending and successfully completing the Sanctions related assigned training in the mandated timeframe
* Understanding the consequences of failing to attend or successfully complete the training as mandated
* Requesting additional training that you deem necessary or appropriate to perform your jobs through your entity manager
* Demonstrate an understanding of Politically Exposed People acceptance, prohibition, guidelines in order to ensure that is fully compliant

Job Title: Promotional Products Marketing Coordinator
  
  
**Experience:**
1–3 years preferred
  
  
**Industry:**
Promotional Products / Branded Merchandise
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Promotional Products Coordinator to support client presentations, product sourcing, pricing, order processing, and supplier coordination. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with platforms such as
**commonsku and ASI/ESP**
, creating customized product presentations, managing purchase orders, and tracking orders from approval through delivery.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Client Presentations: Build professional client presentations in commonsku featuring promotional products, pricing, decoration options, and virtual mockups.
* Presentation Revisions: Update presentations based on feedback from clients and the sales team.
* Estimates and Sales Orders: Convert approved presentations into accurate estimates and sales orders in commonsku.
* Purchase Order Management: Prepare and send purchase orders to suppliers, verifying pricing, quantities, imprint details, and shipping dates.
* Order Tracking: Monitor artwork proofs, production progress, and shipping schedules while keeping clients and sales representatives informed.
* Issue Resolution: Resolve order-related issues, including product backorders, artwork proof revisions, and shipping delays.
* Product and Supplier Sourcing: Use ASI/ESP to identify suitable products and suppliers based on client budgets, quantities, and delivery deadlines.
* Marketing Support: Assist with company store setup, email campaigns, social media posts, and promotional product spotlights.
* Data Accuracy: Maintain accurate product specifications, pricing, order details, supplier information, and delivery records.
* Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate with sales teams, suppliers, and other internal stakeholders to ensure smooth order execution and timely delivery.

Requirements:
  
  
**Required Skills And Qualifications**

* Experience in promotional products, branded merchandise, order coordination, purchasing, sales support, or a related field.
* Familiarity with commonsku and ASI/ESP is preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in pricing, quantities, product specifications, and purchase orders.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple orders, deadlines, and client requests simultaneously.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and follow-up skills.
* Basic proficiency in spreadsheets, email communication, and online business platforms.
* Ability to work collaboratively with sales teams, suppliers, and clients.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience creating product presentations, virtual mockups, and branded merchandise proposals.
* Knowledge of decoration methods such as screen printing, embroidery, engraving, and heat transfer.
* Experience tracking artwork approvals, production timelines, and shipments.
* Familiarity with promotional product sourcing, supplier pricing, and inventory availability.

Ideal Candidate Profile
  
  
The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, customer-focused, and comfortable managing the complete workflow from product sourcing and presentation creation to order placement, production tracking, and final delivery.

title: Study Abroad Tele Counselling
description:
**Company Description**

Studies In Overseas (SIO) is a comprehensive study abroad advisory organization that supports learners in planning and pursuing international education. SIO offers guidance on admissions to 800+ universities and colleges across more than 33 countries, including major destinations such as the USA, UK, Ireland, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Italy, Germany, and France. The team focuses on providing personalized counselling to help individuals choose the right programs and institutions aligned with their goals. SIO values trust and aims to deliver a human-touch experience with speed and accuracy throughout the study abroad journey. The organization is committed to turning global education aspirations into achievable plans.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, on-site Study Abroad Tele Counselling role based in the Greater Kolkata Area. The role involves handling inbound and outbound calls to counsel prospective learners and families on suitable countries, universities, programs, eligibility criteria, and application timelines. The individual will explain admission processes, documentation requirements, and standardized tests, and guide applicants through shortlisting institutions according to academic background, budget, and career goals. Daily tasks include maintaining detailed records in CRM systems, following up with leads, coordinating with internal teams for applications and offers, and providing regular updates to applicants. The role also includes responding to queries via phone, email, and messaging platforms, participating in promotional campaigns, and contributing to webinars or information sessions about studying abroad.

**Qualifications**

* Strong counselling and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex admission and visa information clearly and empathetically.
* Proficiency in telecalling and customer service, including handling high call volumes, lead follow-up, and relationship building.
* Good organizational and documentation skills, with experience using CRM or similar tools to track enquiries, applications, and follow-ups.
* Awareness of international education systems, popular study destinations, and admission processes; prior experience in overseas education consulting is an advantage.
* Ability to work on-site in the Greater Kolkata Area, collaborate in a team environment, and meet targets and deadlines.
* Comfortable using digital tools for communication (email, chat, video calls) and basic office software (word processing, spreadsheets, presentations).
* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; a background in education, counselling, or related fields is preferred.
* Fluency in English; knowledge of regional languages is beneficial for engaging a wider range of applicants.

title: Chartering Manager
description:
**Experience:**
10–15 Years

**Preferred Background:**
Relevant shore-based Chartering experience in the Maritime Transportation sector for Bulk Carriers ( Containers exposure is an added advantage ). Sailing exposure as Chief Mate/Master is good to have.

**Joining Location**
- Kolkata

**Role Purpose**

To lead the
**Chartering & Commercial function**
, ensuring optimum vessel employment, competitive chartering revenue, minimum commercial downtime, effective Charter Party management, timely commercial and claims settlement, and development of new business opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Chartering & Revenue**

* Identify and secure suitable employment for Dry Bulk vessels through
  **Tenders, Voyage Charter and Time Charter**
  opportunities.
* For non-tender vessels, strive to secure charter rates at around
  **95% of the prevailing BDI / relevant BKI, BSI or corresponding market index**
  for the vessel tonnage.
* Evaluate market conditions, vessel positioning, cargo availability and prevailing fixtures before concluding employment.
* Explore
  **3–6 month period employment linked to BDI/FFA scales**
  for identified vessels, based on market opportunities.
* Negotiate freight/hire rates and commercial terms with charterers and brokers within the approved authority framework.

**2. Chartering Efficiency & Vessel Utilisation**

* Minimise commercial off-hire and waiting time between completion of one employment /tender and commencement of the next, and minimise avoidable commercial downtime and loss of earnings.
* Plan vessel repositioning and re-hire opportunities to maximise
  **earning days and fleet utilisation**
  .
* Evaluate options based on recent comparable fixtures for similar tonnage in the relevant region.

**3. Voyage Estimation & Commercial Performance**

* Prepare voyage estimates before fixing Voyage Charters and assess expected
  **TCE and voyage profitability**
  .
* Prepare voyage actuals on completion and analyse variance against estimates.
* Monitor vessel earnings and analyse losses arising from
  **off-hire, idling, ballast, repairs and other commercial downtime**
  .
* Prepare voyage analysis, variance and commercial loss reports for Management review.

**4. Charter Party Management**

* Review fixture recaps and
  **Charter Party terms**
  thoroughly before conclusion.
* Ensure Charter Party terms adequately protect the
  **Owner’s commercial interests**
  and minimise revenue leakage.
* Track disputes arising from concluded Charter Parties and ensure learnings are incorporated into future fixtures.
* Work towards minimising Charter Party disputes and their impact on vessel earnings.

**5. Business Development**

* Identify and develop new
  **chartering, cargo and commercial business opportunities**
  for the Company.
* Drive growth and utilisation of identified business segments and vessels in line with Management targets.
* Explore
  **new container business opportunities and sectors**
  , in addition to the existing Chennai–Kolkata sector.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with
  **charterers, cargo owners, brokers and other commercial partners**
  .

**6. Hire, Receivables & Commercial Closure**

* Ensure timely receipt and settlement of
  **hire/freight and additional recoverable**
  , including AWRP, bunker payments and other applicable amounts.
* Target commercial closure and collection of outstanding amounts
  **within 15 days from completion/end of charter**
  , wherever contractually applicable.
* Coordinate with Finance & Accounts for timely reconciliation and closure of commercial receivables.
* Follow up on outstanding commercial dues and ensure timely escalation wherever required.

**7. Claims & Insurance**

* Coordinate and follow up
  **P&I, H&M, commercial, cargo and other applicable insurance claims**
  .
* Liaise with insurers, P&I Clubs and underwriters for timely processing and settlement of claims.
* Ensure proper documentation and systematic record keeping of claims, correspondence and settlements.
* Support
  **insurance renewals, negotiations and settlements**
  with appropriate Management approval.

**8. Commercial MIS & Reporting**

* Prepare monthly
  **fleet earnings and commercial performance reports**
  within defined timelines.
* Report vessel utilisation, waiting periods, commercial downtime, voyage performance and loss of earnings.
* Support performance reports with relevant
  **freight market and BDI analysis**
  .
* Prepare quarterly and annual commercial analysis and reports required by the CEO and Management/Board.
* Highlight key commercial risks, performance gaps and opportunities for Management review.

**9. Tenders & Commercial Documentation**

* Prepare and review commercial documents for
  **vessel and cargo tenders**
  .
* Ensure accurate and timely submission of tender documentation.
* Maintain proper documentation, approvals and records relating to
  **fixtures, Charter Parties, tenders, claims and other commercial transactions**
  .

**10. Vessel Sale & Purchase Support**

* Assist the CEO in commercial matters relating to the
  **purchase and sale of vessels**
  , as required.
* Review relevant vessel particulars and commercial documentation.
* Provide commercial inputs and analysis to support Management evaluation and decision-making.

**Skills & Competence**

* Strong understanding of
  **Dry Bulk freight markets, Voyage Charter and Time Charter**
  .
* Good network and relationships with
  **charterers, cargo owners, brokers and other industry stakeholders**
  .
* Strong
  **commercial negotiation, analytical and decision-making skills**
  .
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities.
* Commercially driven with a strong focus on
  **revenue, vessel utilisation, cost optimisation and profitability**
  .

title: AVP-Placements (Non EB)
description:
**Function Purpose-**
The Placement Function in our insurance broking company is responsible for ensuring optimal placement of insurance policies for our clients. This function involves liaising with insurance underwriters, analyzing risk profiles, negotiating terms, and securing the most appropriate insurance coverage at competitive rates for our clients.

**Role Purpose-**
The purpose of the Placement Role is to effectively manage the placement process for insurance policies. The role involves analyzing clients' insurance needs, identifying suitable insurance products, negotiating terms with insurers, and facilitating the policy placement to provide the best insurance solutions to clients.

**Key Expectations of the Role -**

1. Insurance Product Analysis and Selection:

Assess clients' risk profiles and insurance needs to determine the appropriate insurance products. Analyze various insurance products available in the market and recommend the most suitable ones for clients.

2. Negotiation and Terms Agreement: Negotiate policy terms, coverage, and premiums with insurance underwriters to ensure optimal terms for clients. Collaborate with insurers to negotiate policy conditions that meet clients' requirements while adhering to compliance and regulations.

3. Policy Placement and Issuance: Facilitate the smooth placement and issuance of insurance policies for clients.  Coordinate with internal departments to ensure accurate policy issuance and timely delivery to clients.

4. Client Engagement and Education: Engage with clients to provide updates on policy placements and ensure they understand the terms and conditions of their insurance coverage. Educate clients on policy features, benefits, and coverage details.

5. Market Research and Trends Monitoring: Stay updated on market trends, insurance products, and industry developments to offer informed recommendations to clients.  Conduct market research to identify emerging insurance products and assess their suitability for clients.

**Personal Qualifications -**

Educational Background: A bachelor's degree in business, insurance, finance, or a related field is preferred.

Experience: Prior experience in insurance placement, underwriting, or related roles within the insurance industry is advantageous.

Certifications: Relevant certifications in insurance broking or risk management are beneficial.

Technology Proficiency: Proficient in using insurance management software and Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.).

title: Senior Business Development Executive
description:
Company Description

Beck & Pollitzer, established in London in 1863, is one of the world’s most experienced industrial engineering services companies, specializing in industrial machine moving and machinery installations. With operations across multiple countries, the company delivers turnkey machinery services globally, ranging from individual machine relocations to complete factory relocations and production line installations.

Beck & Pollitzer India provides customized and cost-effective solutions for new plant setups, equipment sourcing, facility relocations, and equipment rearrangements. The organization also offers heavy lifting, project cargo logistics, control system installations and modifications, piping engineering, contract maintenance, and project management services with skilled manpower support. Candidates joining Beck & Pollitzer India can expect to work on complex, large-scale industrial projects across diverse sectors, contributing to the growth and development of industrial infrastructure.

Role Description

The Senior Business Development Executive will be responsible for driving business growth in the Metal and Heavy Engineering sector. This is a full-time, on-site position based in the Pune Division, requiring a proactive and self-driven professional capable of independently identifying and developing new business opportunities.

The role involves conducting market research, generating leads and RFQs, mapping potential customers, arranging client meetings, and converting business opportunities into revenue. The successful candidate will manage the business development cycle, build a strong customer network, maintain an effective sales pipeline, and develop long-term relationships with industrial customers, EPC contractors, consultants, and key decision-makers. The position requires extensive travel, strong commercial awareness, and the ability to develop new markets with minimal supervision.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and develop new business opportunities within the Metal and Heavy Engineering industry.
* Conduct market research, lead generation, customer mapping, and contact discovery to identify potential clients and target markets.
* Generate RFQs and business inquiries for Greenfield and Brownfield projects, plant expansions, industrial installations, machine relocations, project management, shutdowns, and maintenance services.
* Schedule and conduct customer meetings, presentations, and follow-ups to develop and convert business opportunities.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with industrial clients, consultants, EPC contractors, and key decision-makers.
* Maintain an updated sales pipeline and customer database using CRM tools.
* Prepare business development reports, sales presentations, and market analysis to support strategic decision-making.
* Coordinate with internal technical and project teams to ensure timely submission of proposals and responses to customer inquiries.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and emerging business opportunities within the Metal and Heavy Engineering sector.
* Travel extensively to customer locations to develop new business opportunities and strengthen existing relationships.

Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, or Business Administration. An MBA or M.Tech is preferred.
* 4–6 years of business development experience in the Metal and Heavy Engineering industry, including Steel, Stainless Steel, Aluminium, Copper, Non-Ferrous Metals, Foundries, Rolling Mills, or related sectors.
* Proven experience in market research, lead generation, appointment generation, RFQ and inquiry generation, and customer relationship management.
* Good understanding of the Metal, Steel, Mining, and Heavy Engineering industries.
* Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and client relationship management skills.
* Ability to independently identify business opportunities, develop customer networks, manage sales pipelines, and achieve business targets with minimal supervision.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and target-oriented, with a willingness to travel extensively.
* Fluency in English is mandatory. Knowledge of Hindi, Bengali, or Odia will be an added advantage.

description:

* Regional Business Strategy & Growth

* Establish a robust performance management framework through regular business reviews, field assessments, and individual performance discussions, ensuring clear expectations, objective evaluation, and timely performance interventions.
* Develop the leadership capabilities of direct reports and strengthen the regional talent pipeline through succession planning, talent reviews, cross-functional exposure, and targeted development opportunities.

title: Sales Business Development Executive
description:
Visual Foundry is a creative advertising company building advertising and visual experiences for modern brands.
 



  





 We work across AI\-powered advertising, cinematic commercials, product films, CGI, social creatives and creative production. We also provide advertising and media\-buying services for brands looking to turn creative into measurable growth.
 



  





 We are a growing company with an international focus, including businesses and clients in Australia and other global markets.
 



  





 About the Role
 



  





 We are looking for a Sales \& Business Development Executive to take ownership of our sales process from qualified lead to closed deal.
 



  





 This is a sales\-first role, not a traditional telecalling position.
 



  





 You will speak directly with founders, business owners, marketing teams and decision\-makers, understand what they need, identify the right Visual Foundry solution, handle objections, negotiate, follow up and close.
 



  





 A large part of the role will involve inbound leads generated through our advertising, so speed, communication, qualification and consistent follow\-up are critical.
 



  





 You will also be expected to reactivate suitable older leads and build opportunities from existing prospects.
 



  





 What You'll Do
 



  




* Respond quickly to new inbound leads and initiate professional calls.
* Understand the prospect's business, requirements, budget, timeline and decision\-making process.
* Qualify leads based on genuine buying intent.
* Conduct discovery calls and sales conversations with Indian and international prospects.
* Communicate confidently with founders, business owners and marketing decision\-makers.
* Recommend the right Visual Foundry service based on the client's needs.
* Present proposals and communicate commercial terms clearly.
* Handle questions, objections and pricing conversations professionally.
* Negotiate and move qualified prospects toward a decision.
* Own the sales process from first conversation through
 **closing and payment coordination** 
 .
* Maintain timely and structured follow\-ups so qualified opportunities do not go cold.
* Re\-engage relevant older and previously unconverted leads.
* Keep lead information, follow\-ups and pipeline status accurately updated.
* Work closely with the founder and creative team when a prospect requires deeper creative or strategic discussion.
* Track your pipeline, conversations, meetings, proposals and conversions against targets.



  





 What You'll Be Selling
 



  





 Visual Foundry operates across two core service areas:
 



  





 Creative Production
 



 AI\-powered advertising films, cinematic commercials, product films, CGI, social creatives and other visual advertising assets.
 



  





 Advertising \& Media Buying
 



 Campaign management and advertising services, including Meta advertising, for businesses looking to acquire customers and grow.
 



  





 You don't need to be a creative professional, but you must be willing to understand what we sell well enough to communicate its value to prospects.
 



  





 What We're Looking For
 



  




* **Minimum 1 year of relevant sales or business development experience.**
* Strong spoken and written English.
 **Excellent spoken English is essential.**
* Confident communication skills, especially on calls and meetings.
* Strong listening and questioning ability.
* Ability to understand a prospect's actual need rather than simply pitch a service.
* Strong objection\-handling and negotiation skills.
* Excellent follow\-up discipline and attention to detail.
* Comfortable speaking with founders, business owners and senior decision\-makers.
* Ability to manage multiple prospects and sales conversations simultaneously.
* Comfortable working with CRM systems, spreadsheets or sales\-tracking tools.
* Target\-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership.
* Ability to work independently and take responsibility for moving opportunities forward.

You will navigate increasingly complex situations, growing your personal brand and deepening your technical skills. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions even when the path forward is unclear. Embracing ambiguity, you will use these moments as opportunities to grow and develop a deeper understanding of the business context.
   

  

 In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will collaborate with cross\-functional teams, identify synergies between technology and the firm, and focus on market penetration and revenue growth. Your efforts will contribute to solution development and industry alignment, driving the firm's success in a dynamic environment.

* **5 years of experience**

 .

 **English communication skills**

* Good understanding of sales metrics such as

* Strong customer\-service orientation and ability to handle escalations professionally.

title: Head of International Sales
description:
**Earning a living should never cost a life.** 




  





 That's why Duratuf exists — and the one thing that limits how fast we grow is how fast we hire the right people.
 **That's your seat.** 




  





**About Duratuf** 




 We're an industrial safety company in Kolkata, with our own office and warehouse in the UAE. Our equipment keeps workers safe at 4,142\+ customers across 65\+ countries — when it works, someone gets to go home to their family. We're on our way to 10,000 protected workplaces by 2035\.
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 This role owns that journey. You'll be the single accountable owner of the international GP number, the international sales team, the CRM, and — most critically — the international channel and distribution network that will carry Duratuf worldwide.
 



 You won't inherit a machine. You'll build one.
 



  





**What will you own end to end** 



* The number. Carry and grow a multi\-crore international GP number targeting \~5x growth over three years. Once the plan is jointly locked, you own execution end\-to\-end — no relitigating.
* The channel. Build (not just manage) our international partner and distribution network — a tracked funnel from Identified to Scaled, a growing active\-partner base each year, dormant markets reactivated, and top partners graduated to distributor tiers.
* Retention. Grow to 1,000 active workplaces with real discipline — every customer classified by buying frequency, a weekly at\-risk report, and a recovery playbook you own.
* New categories. Take every new safety product to market internationally with a country\-by\-country GTM plan.
* The team. Hire, lead, and retain the international sales team, scaling from 2–3 to 6–10 — on a real operating rhythm of weekly reviews and quarterly scorecards.



  





**Must Have** 



* 10–14 years in international B2B industrial sales, having carried a real export GP number (safety, PPE, electricals, industrial, or adjacent)
* A partner network you built — and can name, with outcomes attached
* 3–6 distributed direct reports managed, with documented quota and retention results
* Depth across at least two of MENA / SEA / Africa / LATAM / CIS
* A CRM\-led approach — you run forecast, pipeline, and coaching from the CRM, not on top of it
* Export ops fluency: Incoterms, LC/TT, shipping docs; comfort across INR and AED flows
* Margin literacy and integrity that holds under pressure



  





**What success look like** 



* GP delivered at or above plan, quarter after quarter
* A partner network that's growing, active, and paying on time
* ≥85% of active workplaces retained year on year
* Team quota attainment ≥90%, regrettable attrition under 10%
* Rolling forecast accuracy within ±10%
* Top\-20 key accounts growing ≥20% YoY
* 3–5 new countries a year that genuinely move the number



  





**Good to have** 



* Electrical safety, PPE, or broader industrial safety background
* Experience across a dual\-entity (India \+ UAE) export structure
* Familiarity with the Zoho One ecosystem
* A warm distributor network in MENA, Africa, or SE Asia
* Exposure to EOS / Scaling Up / OKR frameworks



  





**Why Join Duratuf** 



* **Work that matters** 
 — a mission you can point to without a slide
* **Global exposure without leaving Kolkata** 
 — 65\+ markets, our own UAE entity
* **AI\-first, genuinely** 
 — a paid Claude account from Day 1, AI on every req
* **Discipline, not chaos** 
 — we run on Scaling Up: quarterly priorities, weekly rhythms
* **You build it** 
 — the engine you create becomes the backbone of a much bigger team



  





 We hire on values, not just skill — Disciplined Execution · Us Before I · Result Oriented · Inclusive Collaboration · Always Innovating · Numbers that Matter.
 



  





 How We Hire
 



 Simple, fair, and fast — a first call, a detailed interview with the CEO, a values conversation, and reference checks. Every candidate hears back at every stage.
 



  





**Apply — let's talk.**
