title: Pre-Sales & Tender Bidding Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Pre\-Sales \& Tender Bidding Specialist / Manager with strong expertise in government and enterprise tendering, RFP/RFQ responses, proposal management and business development support.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in identifying relevant tender opportunities, understanding client requirements, preparing technical and commercial proposals, coordinating with internal technology and digital marketing teams, and ensuring timely and compliant submission of bids.
   

  

 This role will focus on opportunities across digital marketing, website and software development, IT services, digital transformation and AI\-led solutions.
   

  

 The candidate should be able to independently manage the complete tender lifecycle, from opportunity identification and bid qualification to proposal submission and post\-bid coordination.
   

  

**Experience:** 
 3 \- 6 Years
   

  

**Location:** 
 Kolkata (Onsite)
   

  

**‍Key Responsibilities**
 ‍
   

  

**Tender \& Bid Management**
* Identify and track relevant government, PSU, enterprise and private\-sector tenders, RFPs, RFQs and EOI opportunities.
* Monitor tender portals, procurement platforms and other relevant sources for digital marketing and software project opportunities.
* Review tender documents, eligibility criteria, scope of work, technical specifications, evaluation criteria and submission requirements.
* Conduct bid qualification and feasibility analysis based on project scope, capabilities, eligibility, timelines and commercial viability.
* Prepare tender calendars, bid trackers, submission schedules and compliance checklists.
* Ensure all tender submissions are accurate, complete, compliant and submitted within the defined deadlines.
* Coordinate pre\-bid queries, clarifications, corrigenda, extensions and other tender\-related communications.


 ‍
   

  

**Pre\-Sales \& Proposal Development**
* Understand client requirements and translate them into structured technical and business proposals.
* Prepare RFP/RFQ responses, technical proposals, solution write\-ups, capability documents, company profiles and presentations.
* Develop project understanding, proposed approach, implementation methodology, deliverables, timelines and resource plans.
* Coordinate with Technology, Project Management, Digital Marketing, Creative and other internal teams to gather inputs.
* Support the preparation of Statements of Work (SOW), scope documents, assumptions, exclusions and project plans.
* Ensure proposals clearly communicate Web Spiders' capabilities, relevant experience, value proposition and proposed solution.


 ‍
   

  

**Digital Marketing \& Software Project Expertise**
**Support Proposals And Tenders Related To**
* Digital marketing and performance marketing.
* SEO, SEM, social media marketing and content marketing.
* Website design, development and maintenance.
* Web portals, CMS and e\-commerce solutions.
* Mobile application development.
* Custom software development and enterprise applications.
* AI\-powered solutions, chatbots and conversational AI.
* Cloud, DevOps, application support and digital transformation.
* Creative design, branding and multimedia solutions.
* Work with internal experts to understand technical requirements and prepare relevant, client\-focused proposals.


 ‍
   

  

**Technical \& Commercial Coordination**
* Coordinate with technical leads, project managers, solution architects and business stakeholders for proposal inputs.
* Support effort estimation, resource planning, costing and commercial proposal preparation.
* Work with Finance / Accounts and Business Development teams to finalize pricing and commercial terms.
* Review proposal assumptions, dependencies, payment terms, SLAs and contractual requirements.
* Maintain consistency between technical scope, resource estimates, pricing and delivery commitments.
* Escalate risks, deviations, missing information and commercial concerns before submission.


 ‍
   

  

**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Participate in pre\-bid meetings, client discussions, clarification calls and presentations.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely completion of bid deliverables.
* Support client presentations, solution walkthroughs and tender\-related meetings.
* Maintain professional communication with prospective clients, partners and consortium members where applicable.
* Track bid outcomes, feedback, negotiation status and next steps.


 ‍
   

  

**Proposal Documentation \& Knowledge Management**
* Maintain a centralized repository of proposals, tender documents, case studies, credentials and reusable bid content.
* Develop and maintain proposal templates, capability decks, company profiles and solution libraries.
* Track submitted bids, win/loss outcomes, reasons for rejection and improvement opportunities.
* Ensure all bid documentation follows company standards and approval requirements.
* Maintain confidentiality of client information, pricing, business proposals and internal documents.


 ‍
   

  

**‍Required Skills \& Experience**
* 3–6 years of relevant experience in Pre\-Sales, Tender Management, Bid Management, Proposal Management or IT Business Development.
* Should have experienced with any one of the tender platforms (GeBiz/Tender24x7,Gems, any other Gov portals) for the Digital Marketing \& Software Projects.
* Proven experience in handling government / PSU / enterprise tenders, RFPs, RFQs and EOIs.
* Strong knowledge of the complete tender bidding lifecycle.
* Experience in preparing technical and commercial proposals for software, IT services or digital marketing projects.
* Good understanding of website development, software engineering, digital marketing and digital transformation solutions.
* Strong technical writing, documentation and presentation skills.
* Ability to read and interpret tender documents, eligibility criteria and technical requirements.
* Experience coordinating with technical, project delivery, finance and business development teams.
* Strong attention to detail, deadline management and compliance tracking.
* Proficiency in MS Office / Google Workspace, Excel / Google Sheets and PowerPoint / Google Slides.


 ‍
   

  

**Interview Process**
* Application review
* 5–10 minute initial screening call with the TA team
* Technical interviews {Domain specific}
* ‍Practical test conducted in the presence of a panel member
* ‍Role match \& offer

title: Sales Specialist

**Company Description** 
 A.M.JEEWAJEE \& SONS, established in 1985, is a leading distributor and manufacturer in West Bengal, India, serving industrial clients across India and abroad. The company specializes in conveyor, elevator, and roller chains and accessories in both American and German standards, covering a wide range of pitches from 4 mm to 3 inches. Its product portfolio includes heavy series bush chains, double pitch roller chains, RO type heavy\-duty chains, stainless steel chains, leaf chains, gate chains, and slat conveyor chains with linear and curved movements. The organization also supplies attachment chains, hollow pin chains, bucket elevator chains, flow conveyor chains, and various welded and drop\-forged chains used in sponge, rolling mill, sugar, cement, and other major industries. Applicants can expect to join a technically focused, growth\-oriented company with a strong presence in the industrial sector.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time Sales Specialist role based in Kolkata, structured as a hybrid position with both on\-site and work\-from\-home responsibilities. The Sales Specialist will manage and grow a portfolio of industrial clients by promoting the company’s conveyor and chain products, conducting product presentations, and following up on inquiries and leads. Daily tasks include identifying new business opportunities, preparing quotations, negotiating pricing and terms, and coordinating order processing with internal teams. The role also involves providing pre\- and post\-sales customer support, maintaining accurate sales records and reports, and contributing feedback to improve sales strategies and product positioning. The Sales Specialist will collaborate with management to meet sales targets and may support training sessions for clients or colleagues on product features and applications.

title: Sales and Operations Executive
description:
**Week off \- Tuesday

 Send resume at hrm@prepmed.in
   

  

  

 Company Description** 
 PrepMed is one of India’s most promising ed\-tech start\-ups, registered under Atuldeb Learning Solution LLP and launched in 2019\. The company focuses on delivering quality learning programs for NEET aspirants, designed by NEET\-qualified doctors and experienced exam experts. PrepMed aims to support students preparing for one of India’s toughest competitive exams by offering structured, exam\-oriented content and guidance. With a rapidly growing student base, the organization is driven to remove barriers to education and expand access to high\-quality test preparation. PrepMed positions itself as a dynamic, mission\-driven workplace for professionals passionate about education and student success.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Sales and Operations Executive is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Greater Kolkata Area. This role involves managing end\-to\-end sales processes, including lead generation, follow\-up, counseling prospective students and parents, and converting inquiries into enrollments. The executive will coordinate daily operational activities such as tracking admissions, maintaining CRM data, preparing reports, and ensuring smooth execution of classes and programs. Responsibilities include collaborating with academic and marketing teams, addressing customer queries, and supporting initiatives to improve student experience and retention. The role also involves monitoring performance metrics, recommending process improvements, and contributing to the growth of PrepMed’s NEET preparation offerings.
   

  

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Sales and Sales Operations skills to manage leads, drive conversions, and support enrollment targets.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication and Customer Service skills to engage with students, parents, and internal teams professionally.
* Candidates should possess solid Analytical Skills to interpret data, track performance, and suggest operational improvements.
* Relevant experience in ed\-tech, test preparation, or education sales is beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, commerce, education, or a related field is preferred.
* Proficiency in MS Office tools, CRM systems, and basic reporting is an advantage.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment, meet targets, and collaborate across functions.

title: Associate, Treasures Relationship Manager, Consumer Banking Group
description:
**Business Function**
 As the leading bank in Asia, DBS Consumer Banking Group is in a unique position to help our customers realise their dreams and ambitions across 600 branches across the country. As a market leader in the consumer banking business, DBS has a full spectrum of products and services, including deposits (incl. structured solutions for NRI), investments, insurance, mortgages, credit cards and personal loans to help our customers realise their dreams and aspirations at every life stage.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
* To deliver exceptional volume and revenue performance by acquiring and engaging with DBS
* Treasures clients having an AUM \=\> INR 20 Million through “need\-based approach” and ensure client coverage and product penetration through cross\-sell and up\-sell of DBS products and services.
* To manage \& maintain the highest customer satisfaction and service levels through pro\-active client engagement \& relationship management, coordinating internally with DBS Service and Distribution and Product team


**Key Accountabilities**
* Acquire and upgrade quality Treasures clients in the branch location areas
* Engage with existing customers to deepen the wallet share through retention and growth of AUM.
* Accountable for achieving monthly \& annual volume and revenue objective, as agreed.
* Ensure activation of e\-Channels (I\-Banking / M\-Banking/ Online MF/Debit Card) and Savings Book growth
* Ensure proper implementation \& execution of product strategies through effective relationship management.
* Develop the client trust and loyalty for entrenched relationship with DBS through lifestyle and beyond banking propositions
* Ensure optimum product mix and new\- to\- product clients aimed at customer level profitability and enhancing client coverage.
* Drive and deliver exemplary customer service in the local market and uphold DBS service standards.
* Ensure internal and regulatory compliance through strict adherence to DBS sales process, timely risk reviews and exercising due diligence while on\-boarding.
* Ensure exemplary service delivery of these clients by building appropriate workflows and processes incl. doorstep banking etc.


**Job Duties \& Responsibilities**
* Establish, manage and grow the AUM of the elite Treasures Client segment by acquiring and nurturing the client having AUM \=\> INR 10 M
* Ensure timely portfolio review by jointly engaging with Wealth / Investment / Insurance specialist with clients.
* Ensure complete knowledge of all products \& services through continuous skill and knowledge improvement.
* Resolve customer queries and complaints within the agreed TAT as per the DBS customer service policy.
* Provide feedback on market, competition and products, suggest innovations \& ideas for continuous product and service improvements.
* Keep attuned to the current economic and financial markets to be current and proficient to ensure effective engagement with the elite segment of Treasures customers.
* Coordinate and work closely with CBG Relationship Manager peer groups and colleagues, Service teams, Product specialist at branches to ensure that team objectives are met through an environment that nurtures harmony and collaboration through team work
* Work closely with the Line Manager and City / Cluster Head to ensure achievement of common team and Branch objectives.
* Ensure internal and regulatory compliance and address operational risks if any, e.g. Health \& Safety standards, security of premises, AML / KYC and ongoing risk reviews.
* To exercise appropriate due diligence while on\-boarding and engaging with clients.
* Establish DBS as a primary banker for clients and as a prominent wealth management provider in India.
* Organize exclusive lifestyle, sports , music and such other elite engagement events and activities for prospect generation , entrench existing relationship and reinforce the DBS brand in the Private Wealth management space


**Requirements:**
* Sound understanding of financial planning and wealth management products in India
* In\-depth knowledge of local market and competition.
* AMFI / IRDAI / FEDAI certified candidates with BCSBI certification would be an added advantage


**Education / Preferred Qualifications**
* Graduate / Post Graduate with MBA in relevant field


**Core Competencies**
* Effective probing and listening skills.
* Strong Relationship Management and influencing skills
* Self\-driven and ambitious.
* Good written and verbal communication skills
* Results\-orientated \& the ability to deliver results under pressure
* Understanding of competitive positioning
* Strong service orientation, customer\-centric behavior.
* Focused on developing image and good will of the brand
* Creative, inquisitive mind with problem solving abilities.
* Ability to deliver results within tight timelines.
* Attention to details, analyzing abilities.


**Technical Competencies**
* Understanding of HNI Sales/ wealth management product suite, platforms and operational procedures
* Understanding of banking and para\-banking guidelines issued by RBI (local regulations in India) and local laws and regulations that impact businesses in general.
* Understanding of KYC requirements \& Anti\-money Laundering Policies.
* Knowledge of financial markets and products to assist in meaningful engagement with clients.


**Work Relationship**
* Management of clients and prospects for acquisition and deepening of wallet share.
* Close interaction with Treasures Elite Team Leader, City / Cluster Head, Branch Service and Operations team to ensure consistent delivery of volume and revenue targets.
* Close and regular interaction with Branch Product specialists for effective skill / knowledge development of self and explore potential in existing book through joint engagement with clients.


**Mandatory Training**
* GCAP (Group Customer Acceptance Policy)
* BCAP (Business Customer Acceptance Policy)
* AML (Anti Money Laundering) and KYC Guidelines
* PIP (Personal Investment Policy)
* ORM (Operational Risk Management)
* Information Security Policy


**DBS India \- Culture \& Behaviors**
* Performance through Value Based Propositions
* Ensure customer focus by delighting customers \& reduce complaints
* Build pride and passion to protect, maintain and enhance DBS’ image and reputation
* Enhance knowledge base, build skill sets \& develop competencies
* Execute at speed while maintaining error free operations
* Maintain the highest standards of honesty and integrity.


**Location:**
 Kolkata\-DBIL
   

  

**Job:**
 Relationship Management
   

  

**Schedule:**
 Regular
   

  

**Employee Status:**
 Full time

title: Key Accounts Manager Poultry - Kolkata
description:
The Position
 


  


 As a Key Account Manager, you will play a critical role in driving business growth by building strong, sustainable partnerships with key customers across your assigned territory. You will work closely with leadership, customers, and cross\-functional teams to create mutual value, achieve commercial objectives, and deliver business results in line with company strategy.
 


  


 Duties \& Responsibilities
 


  

  
* Achieve sales and profitability targets across key accounts within both broiler and layer segments.
  
* Identify, pursue, and successfully close new business opportunities through the execution of BIAH’s Integrated KAM and Customer Business Planning (CBP) programs.
  
* Consistently seek opportunities to expand business with existing customers while winning new opportunities through strategic account management.
  
* Deliver short and mid\-term financial targets for your assigned customers and territory.
  
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, decision\-makers, and management teams within customer accounts.
  
* Understand customer needs, challenges, and business priorities, and develop solutions that create value for both the customer and BIAH.
  
* Position BIAH as a trusted partner by identifying opportunities for collaboration and mutual growth.
  
* Lead the development of comprehensive customer solutions by combining BIAH products and services into compelling value propositions.
  
* Develop customer\-specific growth strategies based on market analysis, competitive insights, and customer objectives.
  
* Create and execute Key Account Business Plans aligned with local avian business strategies and organizational goals.
  
* Optimize account penetration and maximize share of wallet through strategic planning and execution.
  
* Build and lead effective key account teams to support account growth and opportunity success.
  
* Ensure clear communication, alignment, and successful execution of agreed account strategies.
  
* Collaborate with CX teams, Business Unit Managers, Area Business Managers, Business Service Heads, and other stakeholders to deliver customer success.
  
* Align budgets, investments, and resources with account opportunities to maximize return on investment.
  
* Provide accurate sales forecasts and business updates to support effective planning and decision\-making.
  
* Manage commercial agreements, pricing discussions, and receivables with assigned accounts.
  
* Identify mutual growth opportunities and contribute to performance planning and development discussions for team members.
  
* Regularly assess account potential, sales performance, market share, and growth opportunities by product segment and species.
  
* Gather and analyze market trends, customer insights, and competitive intelligence to strengthen business strategies.
  
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date customer information and activity records within the CRM system.
  
* Develop and execute comprehensive territory and account plans to drive sustainable growth.
  
* Maintain effective customer engagement through planned account interactions and agreed contact frequency.
  
* Utilize data, customer insights, and digital tools to prioritize opportunities and maximize business impact.
  
* Ensure all administrative responsibilities, reporting requirements, and customer records are completed accurately and on time.
  

  


  


 About our Future Employee
 


  

  
* Education : Bachelors degree, Masters degree Veterinary \- Medicine / Economics/ Agriculture degree DVM / Animal Husbandry / Master of Science or Economics and/or Master of Business Administration is preferred.
  
* Customer focused
  
* Leadership competencies
  
* Performance and Return on Investment\-driven personality
  
* Knowledge of Animal Health Industry Economics
  
* Ability to work and thrive in matrix team environment
  
* Proven ability to work cross\-functional
  
* Interpersonal and communication skills
  
* Proven field experience of at least 8\-10 years
  
* History of successful performance.
  
* Good English in word and writing
  
* Proficiency in Excel, Word, Outlook and database applications.
  
* Ability to travel (may include overnight travel).
  
* Should reside in assigned geography or be willing to relocate.
  

  


  


 READY TO APPLY?
 


  


 Click the “Apply On Company website” button. Create an account or sign in and continue to register your profile, upload your resume, and apply in the company site.
 


  

**Our Company**
 Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long\-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,300 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer\-ingelheim.com.
   

  

**Why Boehringer Ingelheim?**

 With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths \- and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.
 



 Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.
 



 Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after \- as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.
 







 Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer\-ingelheim.com

title: Associate Director - Development - Kolkata
description:
Associate Director /Sr. Mgr \- Business Development
   

  

**About The Company**
 Treebo Hospitality Ventures is India’s most loved brand and one of the largest chains in the budget segment of hospitality. With a network of 850\+ hotels across 120\+ cities, Treebo offers travellers the unprecedented value proposition of high\-quality stays at affordable prices wherever they go. We are proud of putting dignity back into budget travel where earlier the traveller was forced to contend with poor quality and hygiene.
   

  

 Treebo Hospitality Ventures masterfully combines engineering prowess with deep hospitality expertise. Our operational ethos is clear and focused from Treebo Club, an innovative distribution platform and extremely rewarding loyalty programme to Hotel Superhero, a cutting\-edge SaaS solution and a comprehensive hotel management software.
   

  

 With a strong technological foundation and a passion for hospitality, THV aims to deliver exceptional experiences across our diverse portfolio. Our range of brands—Itsy Hotels, Treebo, Treebo Premium and Medalio—provides a symphony of choices that blend quality, comfort and affordability.
   

  

 Treebo is a Great Places to Work certified organisation. We take immense pride in our culture which is built on a strong foundation of 7 values. Some of these values include \- “Exhibit Owner Mindset” and “Have the humility and hunger to learn and help learn”, amongst others. * Data driven approach to pitching and supply building
* Energetic and self\-starter, agile and flexible
* Comfortable working hands\-on in a fast\-paced start\-up environment
* Comfortable to travel extensively to any region across the country extensively

 A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

* You will be building relationship with key decision makers in the account Identifying and resolving business issues in top accounts and Implement strategies and drive results for enhancing access to Roche innovations

****Who you are****

title: Head of Fundraising
description:
**Head of Fundraising \& Investor Relations, East – Kolkata** 




 Vantrock Investment Managers LLP
 



  





**Vantrock is a multi\-product real assets platform. Not a warehousing fund.** 
 Logistics and industrial is the first strategy. Office, plotted sales, land, pre\-leased and yielding assets, private credit, data centres and senior living follow behind it. This seat builds the distribution network for all of it in Kolkata and the East.
 



**THE SEAT** 




**Employer:** 
 Vantrock Investment Managers LLP, the investment manager within Vantrock Ventures
 



**Reports to:** 
 Chief Business Officer, Fundraising and Investor Relations. Until that seat is filled, directly to the Founder \& CEO, who will build the franchise with the zonal team hands\-on
 



**Direct reports:** 
 None at launch. A senior single\-contributor seat with a very large number attached
 



**Location:** 
 Kolkata, in office, with twelve to fifteen travel days a month across Kolkata, Guwahati, Bhubaneswar, Patna, Ranchi and Raipur
 



**Experience:** 
 10 to 16 years
 



 Team structure, reporting lines, seat titles and hiring entity reflect the current plan and may change. Compensation is confirmed in the offer.
 



**ABOUT THE COMPANY** 




 Vantrock is an operator\-led real assets platform, and it is multi\-product by design. Real assets only. Warehousing and industrial parks are
 **the first strategy, not the platform** 
 , across the full chain: first mile, last mile, city\-centre, dark\-store and self\-storage formats, and logistics\-anchored mixed\-use with distribution below and office above.
 



 Behind that first strategy sits the rest of the platform, launched in sequence and only as each is delivered: industrial plots; suburban campuses, GCC and back\-office space, where our expertise transfers directly; strata offices; and, in parallel, data centres and senior living. Each is a strategy in its own right, with its own pipeline and its own distributor relationships behind it.
 **A candidate who reads this as a warehousing platform has read the first line and stopped.** 




 Three parts, kept separate. The founder's balance sheet takes the first risk: land is acquired, de\-risked and approved on his capital before any investor commits. Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited develops and operates; Vantrock Investment Managers LLP underwrites every asset independently and answers to an independent Investment Committee. Assets enter at cost, with no founder premium. The platform earns only after its investors have.
 



 Founded by
 **Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO** 
 . Three institutional platforms built from zero, and the fourth now on his own capital. Across that career: India's largest industrial real estate exit, Rs 5,250 Cr to Blackstone; a fund platform taken from zero to about USD 1\.4 billion in peak AUM in six years, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close, Rs 2,775 Cr from roughly 1,000 investors through the channel, on India's first domestic warehousing AIF; 52 million sq ft delivered, 32 million as developer and 20 million as contractor; 2,000\+ acres acquired, all litigation\-free; 200\+ buildings. Delivered across the founder's three prior platforms.
 



**Warehousing is where the founder is best known. It is not where this platform stops.** 
 That record is the anchor that opens the door in the channel. The mandate you would be selling is considerably wider than it.
 



 We hire number twos who want to become number one.
 



**THE PRODUCT SET YOU WOULD BE SELLING** 




 This is the part most candidates get wrong. You would not be carrying one product into the channel. You would be building a channel that carries a succession of products across real assets. The proposed set, built out in sequence as each is delivered and as approvals are obtained:
 



 – Industrial parks, logistics and warehousing
 



 – Office: suburban campuses, GCC and back\-office space, starter and strata office
 



 – Plotted and industrial plot sales
 



 – Pre\-leased and yielding assets
 



 – A land strategy
 



 – Private credit
 



 – Data centres and senior living
 



 – In time, listed or pooled vehicle formats including InvIT and REIT structures
 



**Multiple product lines, one channel.** 
 That is why this is a franchise\-building job rather than a product\-selling job. An RM you certify on the first strategy sells the second, third and fourth without being recruited again.
 



 The intended route is a seeded AIF alongside deal\-by\-deal co\-investment through CIV, co\-investment PMS and other structures, subject to approvals. Seeded is the point: the operator puts assets in place before a fund launches, so much of the pipeline is de\-risked on day one and no blind pool is raised. Two sales in one: a fund commitment into a visible pipeline, and larger co\-investment tickets into named assets.
 



**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS** 




**Own the zone.** 
 Build the distribution and IFA network across East and North\-East India: Kolkata, Guwahati, Bhubaneswar, Patna, Ranchi and Raipur. Activate the RMs and advisers inside it, and convert that network into committed capital for the first strategy and into a channel that is ready when the office, plotted, land, credit and yielding strategies arrive behind it.
 



**Not a cold start.** 
 The platform brings an existing investor base, anchor commitments in place, and a founder known in the channel from two prior funds. The channel will take the meeting. What does not yet exist is the franchise: the empanelments, the certified RMs, the joint calls. There is no team to delegate that to in Year 1\. Seniority here means credibility and judgment, not a desk.
 



**WHAT YOU WILL OWN** 




 – The network. National distributors' regional offices, regional distributors, IFAs and MFDs, DSAs, RIAs, multi\-family offices and wealth\-platform desks. Target 5 to 7 firms empanelled and live.
 



 – The full empanelment cycle, locally. First meeting to product committee to go\-live, for both the fund and the co\-investment routes. Empanel the platform, not a single product, so the next strategy does not start the cycle again.
 



 – Activation. Branch meetings, huddles and desk conversations until 35 to 50 RMs and IFAs have each placed at least one ticket.
 



 – Conversion. Joint client meetings as the core of the job. The pipeline from interest through contribution agreement to funds received.
 



 – The map, in the CRM, weekly. Investor relations in the zone after the close, with Fund Operations. The face of Vantrock in the East.
 



**THIS IS A FRONT\-FACING SEAT** 




 You do not sell to the distributors and stop. You sell with them. Accompany partners and their RMs to their clients and pitch yourself. Tell the story so an RM can repeat it under pressure. Host investor evenings, partner meets and site visits, speak where the channel meets the asset class, and be a named voice of the platform on LinkedIn.
 



**Approved material only. Nothing bespoke, nothing verbal\-only, no return promises, ever.** 




**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




**Essential** 




 – 10 to 16 years in financial services, at least five in B2B or B2B2C distribution of PMS, AIF or mutual\-fund products from the manufacturer's side, an AMC, alternatives manager or fund house. You have carried a distribution number and been paid against it.
 



 – Verifiable relationships with distributor product heads, national and regional distributors and the top IFA and MFD firms in East and North\-East India. You can name them, and they will take your call.
 



 – You have launched a product into the channel from scratch at least once, not only carried an established brand.
 



 – Third\-party capital raised through the channel, stated as capital drawn, not assets influenced.
 



 – Graduate. MBA, PGDM, CA or CFA or equivalent. NISM as applicable.
 



 – Appetite for the road. Twelve to fifteen travel days a month is the job, not an exception to it.
 



**Advantageous** 




 – A real assets fund background. Not mandatory: a strong alternatives channel salesperson from equity, credit or PMS is often the superior hire, because channel sales is harder to teach than an asset class.
 



 – Experience carrying more than one product line into the same channel. This platform will ask you to do it repeatedly.
 



 – An AMC alternates or PMS desk. Co\-investment tickets sold alongside a fund. Standing in the Marwari, Bengali and North\-East business communities, where alternatives penetration is low relative to wealth and a well\-run fund house faces less competition.
 



**COMPENSATION AND WEALTH CREATION** 




 Benchmarked against the upper quartile, then deliberately weighted from take\-home to wealth creation. Four parts, offered as a mix: fixed; a fundraising incentive on the capital you personally bring in, with a team component on the platform's total raise; a share in the platform's additional returns on strategies you help close; and ESOPs. Numbers in the first conversation.
 



**Prepared for recruitment only. Not an offer of, or invitation to invest in, any fund, scheme, security or interest, and not marketing of any investment product. The product lines, structures and routes described are proposed and indicative, subject to change and to all necessary SEBI and other regulatory approvals. The track record above relates to the founder's prior roles at other organisations, is not the track record of Vantrock, and is not indicative of future results. No return is stated or implied, and none may be quoted in connection with this search.** 




 Approve and West follows.

 Exalter Global Co. is looking for an experienced and highly proactive Senior Leather Sales \& Merchandiser to drive international B2B business development.
 



  





 The PRIMARY PURPOSE of this role is:
 



  





 FIND NEW INTERNATIONAL BUYERS → GENERATE ENQUIRIES → DEVELOP SAMPLES → CLOSE EXPORT ORDERS → BUILD LONG\-TERM ACCOUNTS
 



  





 This is NOT a passive account\-management or follow\-up role.
 



  





 We are looking for a sales\-driven BUSINESS HUNTER who can independently identify potential buyers, reach decision\-makers, initiate conversations, generate qualified enquiries and convert prospects into profitable international customers.
 



  





 ABOUT EXALTER GLOBAL CO.
 



  





 Exalter Global Co. is an established Indian manufacturer, exporter and supplier of premium leather goods, serving international B2B customers through OEM manufacturing, private\-label production and customized leather goods development.
 



  





 Our product capabilities include:
 



  





 • Leather Wallets
 



 • Leather Bags
 



 • Belts
 



 • Card Holders
 



 • Passport Holders
 



 • Laptop Bags
 



 • Other Leather Accessories
 



  





 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 1\. NEW INTERNATIONAL BUYER ACQUISITION – PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY
 



  





 • Identify new international buyers for our leather goods manufacturing and private\-label capabilities.
 



 • Research and build qualified buyer databases.
 



 • Identify founders, brand owners, sourcing managers, purchasing managers, procurement teams and category managers.
 



 • Prospect fashion brands, leather goods brands, lifestyle brands, retailers, wholesalers, importers, distributors, sourcing companies, e\-commerce brands and private\-label businesses.
 



 • Develop new B2B opportunities across the USA, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia, Middle East and other relevant markets.
 



 • Conduct proactive outbound prospecting through cold email, LinkedIn, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, B2B platforms, trade databases, directories, referrals, exhibitions and other legitimate B2B channels.
 



 • Initiate conversations with companies that have no previous relationship with Exalter Global Co.
 



 • Qualify prospects based on product requirements, sourcing needs, volumes, pricing and business potential.
 



 • Convert prospects into genuine business enquiries and RFQs.
 



  





 2\. INTERNATIONAL B2B SALES
 



  





 • Manage the complete sales cycle from prospect identification to purchase order.
 



 • Understand buyer requirements, target pricing, MOQ, product specifications and delivery expectations.
 



 • Prepare professional quotations and commercial proposals.
 



 • Conduct buyer discussions and sales presentations.
 



 • Negotiate pricing, MOQ, payment terms, lead times and commercial conditions.
 



 • Handle objections and move qualified opportunities toward sampling and order confirmation.
 



 • Follow up consistently and professionally.
 



 • Maintain a structured international sales pipeline.
 



 • Convert new accounts into repeat customers.
 



  





 3\. LEATHER GOODS MERCHANDISING
 



  





 • Understand leather goods construction, materials and manufacturing processes.
 



 • Handle wallets, bags, belts, card holders, passport holders and related accessories.
 



 • Understand leather types, finishes, thicknesses, colours, textures, hardware and construction.
 



 • Interpret buyer sketches, tech packs, reference images and samples.
 



 • Translate buyer requirements into clear product specifications.
 



 • Coordinate with sampling, sourcing, production and quality teams.
 



 • Recommend commercially viable product and manufacturing solutions.
 



  





 4\. PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT \& SAMPLING
 



  





 • Coordinate prototype and sample development for new buyers.
 



 • Communicate buyer specifications accurately to internal teams.
 



 • Track sample development, revisions and approvals.
 



 • Manage customized branding requirements such as embossing, debossing, foil stamping, printing, engraving, labels and packaging.
 



 • Ensure approved samples are correctly documented for production.
 



  





 5\. COSTING \& QUOTATIONS
 



  





 • Prepare accurate product costing.
 



 • Evaluate leather, hardware, accessories, labour, packaging and manufacturing costs.
 



 • Prepare competitive export quotations while protecting company margins.
 



 • Negotiate commercially viable pricing.
 



 • Understand FOB and relevant international trade terms.
 



 • Maintain accurate costing and quotation records.
 



  





 6\. ORDER CONVERSION \& PRODUCTION COORDINATION
 



  





 • Coordinate confirmed orders with production, sourcing, sampling and quality teams.
 



 • Monitor production schedules and critical milestones.
 



 • Ensure production follows approved samples and specifications.
 



 • Track quantities, quality and delivery timelines.
 



 • Identify potential delays and communicate proactively.

description:
**WE DON'T NEED A SALES HEAD. WE NEED A REVENUE HUNTER.** 




  





 If aggressive targets energize you rather than intimidate you, this role is built for you. We are looking for a Sales Head who can recruit, train and lead a high\-performance sales force capable of selling Digital Marketing, Performance Marketing, Website Development, Mobile \& Web Applications, Branding and Technology Services through cold calling, LinkedIn, bidding platforms, outbound prospecting and unconventional acquisition channels.
 



  





 If you have spent years managing teams, attending meetings and explaining why the targets weren't achieved, this isn't for you. If you've repeatedly taken impossible targets, built hungry teams and smashed them anyway — keep reading.
 



  





**YOUR MANDATE** 




 Build a sales team that doesn't wait for leads — it hunts for opportunities. You will own recruitment, sales training, pitch development, prospecting systems, pipeline management, conversion strategy and monthly revenue delivery. You will set aggressive activity and revenue KPIs, identify what is working, kill what isn't, and personally step into high\-value negotiations when needed. The expectation is simple: build a scalable sales engine and make revenue predictable.
 



  





**WHO WE WANT** 




 We want a commercially aggressive leader with a proven record of chasing ambitious targets and consistently delivering. You should know how to turn freshers into capable salespeople, capable salespeople into closers and closers into future team leaders. Experience in digital marketing, IT services, SaaS, web/app development or other B2B services is strongly preferred. You should be comfortable with pressure, rejection, daily numbers and accountability — and have the instinct to find another route when the obvious one stops working.
 



  





**THE TARGETS WILL BE AGGRESSIVE.** 




**That's intentional.** 
 We want someone who has already demonstrated the ability to chase ₹1Cr\+ or equivalent aggressive revenue targets per month and deliver under pressure. If your best month is still the month you talk about in interviews, you're probably not ready. We want someone who can say:
 



 “Give me the target. I'll figure out the team, strategy and numbers.”
 



  





**YOUR BATTLEFIELD** 




 Cold Calling • LinkedIn Prospecting • Upwork/Freelance \& Bidding Platforms • Outbound Sales • Lead Generation • B2B Partnerships • High\-Ticket Closures
 



  





**YOUR SCOREBOARD** 




 Revenue Generated \| New Clients \| Conversion Rate \| Average Deal Value \| Pipeline Value \| Team Productivity \| Target Achievement
 



  





**AND YES — THE MONEY IS SERIOUS** 




 We offer a competitive
 **fixed salary \+ aggressive uncapped incentives \+ overachievement bonuses \+ quarterly rewards \+ surprise cash/gift rewards \+ performance trips \+ leadership growth opportunities.** 
 Hit 100% of target → full incentive. 125% → accelerated payout. 150% → enhanced incentive \+ bonus. 200%\+ → exceptional performance payout \+ surprise reward, which will blow your mind. The structure is designed so that exceptional revenue creation directly increases your earning potential. There is no reason to cap your income if you refuse to cap your ambition.
 



  





**WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT** 




 You aren't walking into a finished sales department to maintain it. You will build the team, create the process, establish the culture and set the pace. You will have the freedom to experiment, the authority to challenge existing methods and the responsibility to deliver the outcome.
 



  





**BUILD THE SALES MACHINE** 




 Bring the hunger. Bring the aggression. Bring the track record. We'll bring the opportunity — and we'll pay for the results. Let's have a conversation.

 Founded in 1961, WEG is a global electric\-electronic equipment company, operating mainly in the capital goods sector with solutions in electric machines, automation and paints for several sectors, including infrastructure, steel, pulp and paper, oil and gas, mining, among many others.
   

  

 WEG stands out in innovation by constantly developing solutions to meet the major trends in energy efficiency, renewable energy and electric mobility. With manufacturing units in 17 countries and present in more than 135 countries, the company has more than 45,000 employees worldwide.
   

  

 WEG’s net revenue reached R$ 32\.5 billion in 2023, 52\.9% from outside Brazil.
   

  

 Our business areas are divided as follows.
   

  

**Industrial Electro\-Electronic Equipment**
 This area includes electric motors, drives and industrial automation equipment and services, and maintenance services. Electric motors and other related equipment find applications in practically all industrial segments, in equipment such as compressors, pumps and fans, for example.
   

  

**Energy Generation, Transmission and Distribution (GTD)**
 Products and services included in this area are electric generators for hydraulic and thermal power plants (biomass), hydro turbines (small hydroelectric plants or PCH, and hydroelectric generators or CGH)), wind turbines, transformers, substations, control panels and system integration services.
   

  

**Commercial and Appliance Motors**
 In this business area, our focus is the market of single phase motors for durable consumer goods, such as washing machines, air conditioners, water pumps, among others.
   

  

**Paints and Varnishes**
 In this area, which includes liquid paints, powder paints, and electro\-insulating varnishes, we have a very clear focus on industrial applications in Brazil and are expanding to Latin America and other regions.

title: Amazon Account Manager
description:
**Summary**
 :
 


* We are looking for an experienced Amazon Account Manager who can manage client accounts end to end and confidently handle day\-to\-day client communication.
* You will work directly with US\-based clients, understand their business, products, Amazon account setup, priorities, and ongoing requirements, and coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth execution across listings, catalog, inventory, operations, account health, reporting, and other marketplace activities.
* This is a client\-facing role, so strong communication skills and prior experience working with international clients are essential. We are looking for someone who can take ownership, identify issues, advise clients, follow up internally, and make sure things get resolved properly.



  





**Key Responsibilities**



* Manage a portfolio of Amazon client accounts on a day\-to\-day basis.
* Act as the main point of contact for assigned US\-based clients.
* Onboard new clients and understand their products, business goals, Amazon setup, and priorities.
* Handle regular client calls, emails, meetings, updates, and follow\-ups.
* Support clients in growing their Amazon business by advising on sales strategy, marketing opportunities, promotions, product positioning, and ways to improve account performance.
* Maintain a clear understanding of ongoing activities across each client account.
* Coordinate with internal teams handling catalog, listings, inventory, operations, analytics, finance, and support.
* Monitor product listings, inventory, orders, fulfillment, returns, account health, and seller performance.
* Identify account\-related or operational issues and coordinate with the relevant teams for resolution.
* Track pending tasks and ensure client requests and internal commitments are completed on time.
* Keep clients updated on progress, issues, performance, and next steps.
* Understand Amazon policies, listing requirements, seller performance metrics, and marketplace processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve sales, account performance, and overall operations.
* Take complete ownership of assigned accounts rather than simply passing queries between teams.



  





**Requirements**



* 3\-5 years of experience in Amazon account management, e\-commerce operations, marketplace management, or a similar role.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Amazon Seller Central and/or Vendor Central.
* Prior experience working directly with international clients is a must.
* Experience handling US\-based clients will be strongly preferred.
* Strong written and spoken English with the confidence to communicate professionally over calls, emails, and meetings.
* Good understanding of:


1. Product listings and catalog management
2. Inventory management
3. Orders and fulfillment
4. Returns
5. Account health
6. Seller performance
7. Amazon policies and compliance


* Experience managing Amazon accounts for brands or sellers.
* Ability to understand client requirements, identify problems, recommend solutions, and take ownership until resolution.
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Comfortable working with multiple internal teams at the same time.
* Good working knowledge of Excel and Google Sheets.
* Organised, proactive, dependable, and comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment.



  





**What We’re Looking For**



* We are looking for someone who understands Amazon beyond just one area of operations and is equally comfortable managing the client relationship and managing the account.
* You should be able to confidently discuss listings, catalog issues, inventory, account health, seller performance, sales, marketing opportunities, and account growth with clients while ensuring the required work gets executed properly internally.
* The ideal candidate will be comfortable working with international clients, communicating professionally, and taking complete ownership of their assigned accounts.

title: Manager - Thermal Sales (Alu & Dri)
description:
**Job Summary**
 The Manager – Thermal Sales (ALU \& DRI) is responsible for driving sales growth and business development for thermal products in the Aluminium (ALU) and Direct Reduced Iron (DRI) segments across specified territory across Eastern and Central India. The role focuses on achieving sales targets, managing key customer relationships, identifying new business opportunities, providing technical and commercial support, negotiating contracts, and ensuring customer satisfaction. The incumbent collaborates closely with cross\-functional teams, monitors market trends and competitor activities, develops strategic sales plans, and contributes to business profitability while ensuring compliance with company policies and safety standards.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve revenue, volume, and profitability targets for the assigned territory.
* Manage key customer accounts in the Aluminium (ALU) and DRI segments while strengthening long\-term business relationships.
* Identify and develop new business opportunities to expand the customer base and market share.
* Conduct regular customer visits to understand technical requirements, resolve issues, and provide value\-added solutions.
* Prepare techno\-commercial proposals, quotations, and negotiate pricing and commercial terms.
* Coordinate with Production, Technical Services, Supply Chain, Finance, and Customer Service teams to ensure timely order execution and customer satisfaction.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer requirements to identify growth opportunities.
* Prepare sales forecasts, demand plans, and periodic MIS reports for management review.
* Ensure timely collection of receivables and maintain healthy customer credit management.
* Participate in technical discussions, product trials, and application development at customer sites.
* Represent the organization during customer meetings, industry events, exhibitions, and technical seminars.
* Maintain accurate records in CRM/ERP systems and ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Support product launches, business expansion initiatives, and strategic projects as assigned.
* Ensure adherence to all safety, quality, ethical, and statutory requirements while conducting business activities.


**Profile/Competencies**
 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Metallurgical, Ceramic, Chemical, or related discipline).
* MBA/PGDM in Marketing or Sales Management will be an added advantage.


**Experience**
* 8–12 years of experience in B2B industrial sales, preferably in refractories, thermal products, steel, aluminium, or allied process industries.
* Experience in handling customers within the Aluminium, Non\-ferrous and DRI segments is preferred.


**Technical Competencies**
* Strong understanding of thermal/refractory products and their industrial applications.
* Knowledge of Aluminium, Non\-ferrous and DRI manufacturing processes.
* Techno\-commercial negotiation and contract management.
* Sales forecasting, budgeting, and territory management.
* CRM and ERP systems (preferably Oracle/SAP) and MS Office proficiency.


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Strong customer relationship management skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation abilities.
* Commercial acumen and business development mindset.
* Analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Results\-oriented with strong execution capability.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across cross\-functional teams.
* High level of ownership, integrity, and accountability.
* Willingness to travel extensively across the assigned region.


**Calderys Group**
 Calderys is a leading global solution provider for industries operating in high temperature conditions . The Group specializes in thermal protection for industrial equipment with a wide range of refractory products, and advanced solutions to enhance steel casting, metallurgical fluxes and molding processes.
   

  

 As an international business with a presence in more than 30 countries and a strong footprint in the Americas through the brand HWI, a member of Calderys, we offer our employees a world of opportunity.
   

  

 With a legacy of over 150 years, and an unwavering commitment to excellence, we continue to shape our future through teamwork, customer\-centricity and a proactive mindset. We are the vital partner of all high temperature industries and our purpose places sustainability and innovation at the heart of our business. It reflects our reason for existing: to support our customers building a better world through sustainable solutions.
   

  

 Our values are a driving force in this purpose: We are tenacious, accountable, multicultural and authentic..
   

  

 In our company, performance is recognized and learning is promoted. Our services and solutions depend upon the expertise and commitment of our employees. So we ensure that they have the scope and opportunities to develop their potential within a diverse, inclusive and collaborative setting. It is an environment for people to grow, where every day is a new day and more exciting than the last.
   

  

 Calderys \- Forged in legacy. Fueled by excellence.
   

  

 For more information, please visit Calderys.com
